_comment: Homebrew profession abilities, keyed by THEME. Each theme is an ordered ladder of abilities tagged with a power level 0-5 (0=garbage .. 5=top), matching the campaign's profession tier ladder. profession_abilities.py picks abilities near a target power derived from the profession's tier (from its name) and the rank band (rank-5 entries pick a weaker band than the rank-15 True-Calling entry). Each ability is rendered as a class-feature-style block on the FoundryVTT sheet: a bold name + flavor/mechanics HTML, optionally with pf1 'changes' (passive bonuses that stack onto the bundled item), 'contextNotes' (conditional notes), and a 'uses' pool. Descriptions support {class}/{level}/{half_level} placeholders filled from the actual character. Mechanical formulas use pf1 v11 syntax (ifelse()/gte(), @abilities.*.mod, @attributes.hd.total). Keep formulas conservative; anything not safely automatable is descriptive-only.

martial.name: Drilled Footwork (Ex)
martial.desc: Endless drilling keeps you balanced and ready. You gain a +1 dodge bonus to AC and to CMD whenever you are not flat-footed.

martial.name: Parade Bearing (Ex)
martial.desc: Years on the muster ground taught you to stand tall and look the part. You gain a +2 competence bonus on Intimidate checks made to demoralize foes.

martial.name: Quartermaster's Eye (Ex)
martial.desc: You know good steel from scrap at a glance. You gain a +2 competence bonus on attack rolls made to confirm critical hits, the small edge of a soldier who keeps a keen edge.

contextNotes.text: +2 to confirm critical hits

martial.name: Weapon Discipline (Ex)
martial.desc: You have trained relentlessly with your favored weapon. You gain a +1 bonus on attack rolls and a +1 bonus on damage rolls with it (treat as Weapon Focus and the start of Weapon Specialization).

martial.name: Shield Brace (Ex)
martial.desc: You set your shield and brace against the charge. You gain a +1 shield-trained bonus to AC, and you may treat it as a +1 dodge bonus against the first attack made against you each round.

martial.name: Bloodied Resolve (Ex)
martial.desc: A veteran does not flinch when the fighting turns grim. You gain a +1 morale bonus on saving throws against fear and on Will saves while an enemy is adjacent to you.

contextNotes.text: +1 morale vs fear and on Will saves while an enemy is adjacent

martial.name: Maneuver Training (Ex)
martial.desc: Choose two combat maneuvers (such as disarm, trip, grapple, or sunder). You gain a +2 bonus on combat maneuver checks made with those maneuvers, and using them does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

contextNotes.text: +2 CMB and no AoO with your two chosen maneuvers

martial.name: Brawler's Fury (Ex)
martial.desc: As a swift action you can enter a focused fury for 1 minute, gaining the benefit of a single combat feat you do not possess (you must meet its prerequisites). You can use this once per day.

martial.name: Combat Reflexes Drill (Ex)
martial.desc: Sentry training keeps your blade always moving. You may make a number of attacks of opportunity each round equal to 1 + your Dexterity modifier, and you can do so even while flat-footed.

martial.name: Phalanx Veteran (Ex)
martial.desc: You fight best shoulder to shoulder. You gain a +1 dodge bonus to AC and a +1 morale bonus on attack rolls whenever at least one ally is adjacent to you and engaged with the same foe.

contextNotes.text: +1 dodge AC and +1 morale to attack while flanking with an ally

martial.name: Weapon Training (Ex)
martial.desc: Like a veteran fighter, you have mastered a whole group of weapons. You gain a +2 bonus on attack and damage rolls with weapons of your trained group; the campaign treats your effective training as eight levels higher than normal, so this bonus is already strong for your level.

martial.name: Armor Training (Ex)
martial.desc: You wear armor like a second skin. Reduce your armor check penalty by 2 (minimum 0) and increase your armor's maximum Dexterity bonus by 2. The campaign treats your armor training as eight levels higher, and you move at full speed in medium armor.

martial.name: Battle Hardened (Ex)
martial.desc: Countless campaigns have toughened you against punishment. You gain damage reduction 2/— against weapon attacks and a +2 bonus to your CMD against all combat maneuvers.

martial.name: Whirlwind Reach (Ex)
martial.desc: You sweep your weapon in a controlled arc that few can slip past. As a standard action you can make a single melee attack against every foe within reach, and you gain a +2 untyped bonus on those attack rolls.

contextNotes.text: +2 to attack on a whirlwind sweep of all foes in reach

martial.name: Martial Flexibility (Ex)
martial.desc: You adapt mid-fight like a brawler. As a swift action you gain the benefit of one combat feat for 1 minute (or two feats as a move action). You can use this a number of times per day equal to 3 + half your level, and the chosen feats can satisfy each other's prerequisites.

martial.name: Martial Training (initiator)
martial.desc: A master-at-arms taught you the secrets of a martial discipline. You become an initiator: you learn three maneuvers and one stance from a single Path of War discipline, with an initiator level equal to half your character level. You ready and recover these maneuvers as a martial adept.

martial.name: Banner of the Vanguard (Ex)
martial.desc: Your standard rallies those who follow you. Allies within 60 feet who can see your banner gain a +2 morale bonus on saving throws against fear and a +1 morale bonus on attack rolls made while charging; you yourself gain the same benefit.

contextNotes.text: +2 morale vs fear from your banner

martial.name: Unstoppable Onslaught (Ex)
martial.desc: You crash through the line like a war engine. When you charge you ignore difficult terrain and the first creature in your path, and your charge attack deals an extra 2d6 damage and gains a +4 bonus to its combat maneuver check to overrun or bull rush.

contextNotes.text: +2d6 damage on a charge

martial.name: Peerless Warrior (Ex)
martial.desc: You fight as a legend of the battlefield. You gain a +4 bonus on attack and damage rolls and a +2 dodge bonus to AC. Once per round when you confirm a critical hit, the target must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC 10 + half your level + your Strength modifier) or be staggered for 1 round. You treat every weapon you wield as though it had a +2 enhancement bonus.

martial.name: Warlord's Mastery (Ex)
martial.desc: You are a living legend of the battlefield whose every blow finds its mark. You gain an additional attack at your full base attack bonus on any full attack, a +3 untyped bonus on all attack and damage rolls, and a +3 dodge bonus to AC. Allies within 30 feet gain a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls so long as you fight.

ki.name: Still Mind (Ex)
ki.desc: Your meditative training steadies your spirit. You gain a +2 bonus on saving throws against enchantment spells and effects.

contextNotes.text: +2 vs enchantment

ki.name: Breath Counting (Ex)
ki.desc: Quiet, measured breathing settles your nerves before any task. Once per hour you may take 10 on a Wisdom- or Charisma-based skill check even when distracted or threatened.

ki.name: Centered Stance (Ex)
ki.desc: You root yourself like an old pine. You gain a +2 untyped bonus to your CMD against bull rush, drag, reposition, and trip attempts, and against any attempt to move you against your will.

contextNotes.text: +2 CMD vs bull rush, drag, reposition, trip, and forced movement

ki.name: Calm Heart (Su)
ki.desc: Years of meditation slow your pulse to a whisper. You gain a +1 insight bonus on Fortitude saves against effects that would exhaust, fatigue, sicken, or nauseate you.

ki.name: Quiet Step (Su)
ki.desc: You move with the silence of falling snow. You gain a +2 untyped bonus on Stealth and Acrobatics checks, and you leave no trace of your passing that ordinary tracking could follow.

ki.name: Inner Clarity (Su)
ki.desc: A focused mind perceives what hurried eyes miss. You gain a +2 insight bonus on Perception and Sense Motive checks, and you are never caught flat-footed merely for being surprised by a foe you have already noticed.

ki.name: Lesser Ki Pool (Su)
ki.desc: You have a small reservoir of ki equal to half your level + your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). As a swift action you can spend 1 ki point to increase your speed by 20 feet for 1 round, or to gain a +1 dodge bonus to AC until your next turn.

ki.name: Swift Recovery (Su)
ki.desc: So long as you have at least 1 point in your ki pool, you recover double the normal hit points and ability damage from resting and natural healing. You may spend 1 ki point to heal an additional amount of ability damage equal to your Wisdom modifier.

ki.name: Meditative Trance (Su)
ki.desc: You can enter a restorative trance in place of sleep, gaining a full night's rest in only four hours and remaining dimly aware of your surroundings. While in the trance you cannot be magically put to sleep, and you wake instantly at the first sign of danger.

ki.name: Borrowed Ki (Su)
ki.desc: You may draw a measure of ki from a willing ally in meditation. You can do this a number of times per day equal to half your level plus your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). As a standard action while touching a willing creature you spend 1 ki point to grant them a +2 dodge bonus to AC and a +2 bonus on their next saving throw for 1 minute.

ki.name: Ki Pool (Su)
ki.desc: You command a ki pool equal to half your level + your Wisdom modifier. As a swift action you can spend 1 ki point to make one additional unarmed attack on a full attack, gain a +4 dodge bonus to AC for 1 round, or increase your speed by 20 feet for 1 round. Your unarmed strikes count as magic for overcoming damage reduction.

ki.name: Composure (Su)
ki.desc: Your serene focus is a shield. While you have at least 1 ki point you gain a +1 bonus on saves against fear and emotion effects and increase the DC of Sense Motive checks against you by 2. As an immediate action you can spend 1 ki point to increase that DC by 10, and you can reduce the severity of any fear effect on you by one step.

ki.name: Wholeness of Body (Su)
ki.desc: You channel ki to knit your own flesh. You have a pool of ki points equal to half your level plus your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). As a standard action you may spend 2 of those ki points to heal yourself a number of hit points equal to your character level. You may use this only on yourself.

ki.name: Empty Mind (Su)
ki.desc: You can void your thoughts and let danger pass through you. You draw on a pool of ki points equal to half your level plus your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). As an immediate action you may spend 1 ki point to gain a +4 insight bonus on a single saving throw, or to suppress a fear, confusion, or daze effect on you until your next turn.

ki.name: Four Ki Powers (Su)
ki.desc: Decades of discipline let you channel ki into supernatural feats. Choose four ki powers from the qunlocked monk list (such as elemental fury, barkskin, high jump, or a self-only abundant step). Each costs 1-2 ki points to activate and uses your monk-style ki pool.

ki.name: Diamond Body (Su)
ki.desc: Your purified body resists corruption. You are immune to poison and disease, and you may spend 1 ki point as an immediate action to reroll a failed Fortitude save.

ki.name: Slow Time (Su)
ki.desc: In moments of perfect focus the world seems to crawl. You draw on a pool of ki points equal to half your level plus your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). As a swift action you may spend 2 ki points to act as though hasted for 1 round, gaining an extra attack on a full attack, +1 to attack and AC, and +30 feet of speed.

ki.name: Empty Body (Su)
ki.desc: You let your physical form fade toward the spirit world. Once per day, as a swift action, you may spend 3 ki points to become incorporeal for 1 round per character level, as if by the etherealness spell affecting only yourself.

ki.name: Perfect Self (Su)
ki.desc: You have transcended ordinary limits. Your ki pool increases by 50%. You gain damage reduction 10/chaotic, immunity to fear and charm effects, and you may learn ki powers of any level. Once per day you may spend 3 ki points to take an extra standard action on your turn.

ki.name: Timeless Body (Su)
ki.desc: Your perfected body stands outside the flow of years. You no longer take penalties to your physical ability scores from aging and cannot be magically aged, you no longer need to eat, drink, or breathe, and you are immune to poison, disease, paralysis, and energy drain. While you have at least 1 ki point you gain fast healing 2.

divine.name: Orisons (Sp)
divine.desc: You can cast guidance, light, and stabilize at will as spell-like abilities (caster level equal to your character level).

divine.name: Whispered Litany (Ex)
divine.desc: {class} murmurs the rote prayers of the faith without fail, earning the trust of the devout. Grants a +1 circumstance bonus on Diplomacy checks made with co-religionists.

divine.name: Censer-Bearer (Ex)
divine.desc: Long hours tending the holy incense and reliquaries have made {class} a competent keeper of sacred lore. Grants a +1 competence bonus on Knowledge (religion) checks.

divine.name: Sacred Touch (Su)
divine.desc: As a standard action you can automatically stabilize a dying creature merely by touching it. You may also remove the fatigued condition from a willing creature by touch once per hour.

divine.name: Faithful Heart (Ex)
divine.desc: An unshakable conviction steadies {class} against the terrors that prey upon the doubtful. Grants a +1 morale bonus on saving throws against fear effects.

contextNotes.text: +1 morale on saves vs. fear

divine.name: Blessed Ward (Su)
divine.desc: Once per day {class} may trace a holy sign and grant a single ally within 30 feet a +1 sacred bonus to AC until the end of their next turn, as a swift action.

divine.name: Forever Acolyte (Sp)
divine.desc: Choose two spells of 1st or 2nd level from the cleric spell list. You can cast each of them twice per day as a spell-like ability (caster level equal to your character level).

divine.name: Lay on Hands (Su)
divine.desc: You can heal wounds by touch, restoring 1d6 hit points per two character levels (minimum 1d6). You can do so a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier; using it on yourself is a swift action.

divine.name: Mantle of Prayer (Su)
divine.desc: The faith of {class} wreaths them in a faint protective aura. Grants a +1 sacred bonus on all saving throws.

divine.name: Healer's Vigil (Sp)
divine.desc: {class} channels minor restorative magic to tend the wounded between battles. Usable a number of times per day equal to 3 + their Wisdom modifier, each use mends light injuries as cure light wounds.

divine.name: Destructive Smite (Su)
divine.desc: You channel divine wrath into a blow. As a swift action, declare a destructive smite to add a morale bonus on a single melee damage roll equal to your character level (minimum 1). You can use this a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

divine.name: Domain Mastery (Sp)
divine.desc: You gain the granted power of one cleric domain and can cast that domain's 1st- and 2nd-level spells once each per day as spell-like abilities (caster level equal to your character level).

divine.name: Smiting Prayer (Su)
divine.desc: A number of times per day equal to one quarter your character level (minimum 1), {class} may invoke their deity's wrath as a swift action, adding their Charisma modifier as a bonus on attack rolls and their {level} as a bonus on a single damage roll against an evil foe for 1 round.

contextNotes.text: +Cha mod attack, +{level} damage vs. evil when active

divine.name: Sanctified Bulwark (Su)
divine.desc: A halo of divine protection turns aside blows that would fell a lesser servant. Grants a +2 sacred bonus to AC and a +2 sacred bonus on all saving throws.

divine.name: Divine Channeler (Su)
divine.desc: You channel positive (or negative) energy in a 30-foot burst to heal or harm for 1d6 per two character levels (Will half), usable 3 + your Charisma modifier times per day. In addition, once per day you may cast a 3rd-level divine spell of your choice (such as prayer, dispel magic, or searing light) as a spell-like ability.

divine.name: Voice of the God (Sp)
divine.desc: Once per day you can invoke a 6th-level divine spell as a spell-like ability — such as word of chaos, blade barrier, or heal — by shouting a prayer to your deity (caster level equal to your character level).

divine.name: Wrath of the Heavens (Sp)
divine.desc: {class} calls down a column of searing divine light, hurling flame strike at their foes. Usable a number of times per day equal to 1 + their Charisma modifier, with a caster level equal to their {level}.

divine.name: Shield of Faith Eternal (Su)
divine.desc: Unwavering devotion hardens into a permanent ward against harm. Grants a +3 deflection bonus to AC and a +3 sacred bonus on all saving throws.

divine.name: Avatar of the Faith (Su)
divine.desc: Your deity's power flows through you. Once per day as a swift action you become an avatar for 1 minute, gaining DR 10/epic, fast healing 5, a +4 sacred bonus to AC and on saves, and immunity to fear and compulsion. Once per week you may cast a single 7th-level divine spell (such as resurrection or regenerate) as a spell-like ability.

divine.name: Hand of the Divine (Su)
divine.desc: {class} becomes a perfect conduit of their god's power, their every word and deed shaped by the heavens. Grants a +4 sacred bonus on all saving throws and the ability to channel greater restoration once per day as a spell-like ability at a caster level equal to their {level}.

arcane.name: Arcane Cantrips (Sp)
arcane.desc: You can cast detect magic, mage hand, prestidigitation, and ray of frost at will as spell-like abilities (caster level equal to your character level).

arcane.name: Prestidigitation (Sp)
arcane.desc: The {class} can cast prestidigitation at will, performing minor magical tricks to clean, soil, chill, warm, flavor, or color small objects.

arcane.name: Read Magic (Sp)
arcane.desc: The {class} can cast read magic at will, deciphering arcane glyphs, scrolls, and spellbooks of any written tradition.

arcane.name: Spark of Talent (Sp)
arcane.desc: Once per day the {class} may cast a single 1st-level arcane spell of their choice, a faint glimmer of untrained potential.

arcane.name: Detect Magic (Sp)
arcane.desc: The {class} can cast detect magic at will, sensing the presence and rough strength of magical auras nearby.

arcane.name: Cantrip Repertoire (Sp)
arcane.desc: The {class} knows a full repertoire of arcane cantrips (such as acid splash, dancing lights, daze, detect magic, and mage hand). A number of times per day equal to 3 + their Intelligence modifier they may cast any one of these cantrips as a spell-like ability (caster level equal to their character level).

arcane.name: Apprentice Spellcasting (Sp)
arcane.desc: Choose two spells of 1st or 2nd level from the wizard/sorcerer spell list (such as mage armor, shield, or magic missile). You can cast each twice per day as a spell-like ability (caster level equal to your character level).

arcane.name: Mage Armor (Sp)
arcane.desc: Once per day the {class} can sheathe themselves in mage armor, conjuring a tangible field of force that wards off blows for the better part of a day.

arcane.name: Scholar's Insight (Ex)
arcane.desc: Years bent over grimoires sharpen the {class}'s recall of arcane lore. They gain a +2 competence bonus on Knowledge (arcana) checks, and may always take 10 on Knowledge (arcana) even when distracted or threatened.

arcane.name: Arcane Pool (Su)
arcane.desc: You hold a reservoir of arcane energy equal to half your level + your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1). As a swift action you can spend 1 point to grant a weapon you hold a +1 enhancement bonus (to a maximum of +1 per four levels) for 1 minute.

arcane.name: Spell Combat & Spellstrike (Su)
arcane.desc: You fight like a magus. Once per round you may cast a spell with a casting time of 1 standard action and make a melee attack in the same round (taking a -2 penalty on the attack). When you cast a touch spell, you may deliver it through a melee weapon strike as a free action.

arcane.name: Metamagic Adept (Su)
arcane.desc: The {class} can warp the shape of a spell as it leaves their mind. A number of times per day equal to one quarter their character level (minimum 1) they may apply a single metamagic feat they know to a spell without increasing its level or casting time.

arcane.name: Battle Scholar's Ward (Su)
arcane.desc: The {class} weaves a constant lattice of protective glyphs around themselves. They gain a +2 insight bonus on all saving throws.

arcane.name: Counterspell Mastery (Su)
arcane.desc: The {class} reads the flow of a hostile incantation and unravels it. A number of times per day equal to one third their character level (minimum 1) they may attempt to counter an enemy spell as an immediate action, making a caster level check (DC 11 + the spell's caster level) in place of readying an action and identifying the spell.

arcane.name: Arcane Bombardment (Sp)
arcane.desc: Once per day each, you can cast fireball and lightning bolt as spell-like abilities at a caster level equal to your character level. You may apply one metamagic feat you know to these without increasing their casting time.

arcane.name: School Mastery (Sp)
arcane.desc: You gain the 1st-level granted power of one arcane school and can cast that school's signature 3rd-level spell once per day as a spell-like ability (caster level equal to your character level).

arcane.name: Spell Penetration (Ex)
arcane.desc: The {class}'s spells bore through magical defenses with practiced force. They gain a +2 bonus on caster level checks made to overcome a creature's spell resistance.

contextNotes.text: +2 on caster level checks to overcome spell resistance

arcane.name: Empowered Channeling (Su)
arcane.desc: Raw arcane force suffuses the {class}'s every casting. A number of times per day equal to one quarter their character level plus their Intelligence modifier (minimum 1) they may empower a damaging spell as they cast it, increasing all variable, numeric damage it rolls by half (+50%) without increasing its level or casting time.

arcane.name: Archmage's Secret (Sp)
arcane.desc: Your mastery rivals an archmage. Your caster level increases by 2 for all your spellcasting and spell-like abilities. Once per day you may apply Quicken Spell to any spell you cast without increasing its level, and once per day you may cast a single 7th-level arcane spell (such as teleport, limited wish, or prismatic spray) as a spell-like ability.

arcane.name: Worldwalker's Sanctum (Sp)
arcane.desc: The {class} commands space itself, able to teleport at will and, once per day, raise a mage's magnificent mansion as an extradimensional refuge worthy of an archmage.

alchemy.name: Alchemical Eye (Ex)
alchemy.desc: You gain a +4 bonus to identify potions and alchemical substances, and you can craft mundane alchemical items in half the normal time.

alchemy.name: Stained Fingers (Ex)
alchemy.desc: Years of careless mixing have left your hands reeking of reagents but trained to know them. You can identify any common alchemical substance, potion, or poison by smell as a standard action with no check, and you gain a +2 competence bonus on Craft (alchemy) checks to identify substances.

alchemy.name: Cracked Beaker (Ex)
alchemy.desc: Your leaky apparatus belches foul vapors when you work, which you have learned to aim. Three times per day as a standard action you can hurl a flask of choking reek into an adjacent square; the target must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC 10 + half your character level + your Intelligence modifier) or be sickened for 1 round.

alchemy.name: Apothecary's Apprentice (Ex)
alchemy.desc: A passable hand at the workbench, you brew minor tinctures and identify simple poisons and curatives. You gain a +2 competence bonus on Craft (alchemy) checks.

alchemy.name: Tincture Brewer (Ex)
alchemy.desc: This character keeps a satchel of homemade tinctures and salves, distilled from herbs and reagents over long evenings. Their familiarity with reagents sharpens their analytical eye.

alchemy.name: Smoke and Reagents (Ex)
alchemy.desc: A flair for theatrical chemistry lets this character produce colored smokes, harmless flashes, and pungent vapors to dazzle an audience or cover a retreat. It impresses the unschooled.

alchemy.name: Bombs (Su)
alchemy.desc: You can throw splash bombs a number of times per day equal to your character level + your Intelligence modifier. A direct hit deals 1d6 fire damage per two character levels (minimum 1d6) plus your Intelligence modifier; creatures in adjacent squares take splash damage equal to the minimum.

alchemy.name: Volatile Reagents (Ex)
alchemy.desc: This character stocks unstable compounds that flare and sting on contact, hurled in a pinch as improvised splash weapons. Handling such volatile stock has hardened their nerves against caustic mishaps.

contextNotes.text: +2 vs. acid and against ongoing alchemical effects

alchemy.name: Field Apothecary (Ex)
alchemy.desc: You carry a kit of salves, smelling-salts, and curative draughts. You gain a +3 competence bonus on Heal checks. A number of times per day equal to 3 + your Intelligence modifier you can spend a standard action to administer a draught that stabilizes a dying creature and heals it 1d8 + your character level hit points.

alchemy.name: Mutagen (Su)
alchemy.desc: Once per day you can brew and drink a mutagen. For 10 minutes per level it grants a +4 alchemical bonus to one physical ability score and a +2 natural armor bonus, at the cost of a -2 penalty to a mental ability score.

alchemy.name: Splash Weapon Mastery (Ex)
alchemy.desc: You treat thrown splash weapons as if you had the Far Shot feat, you add one extra adjacent square to any splash, and you may adjust the grid square a missed splash weapon lands in by one square.

alchemy.name: Poisoner's Craft (Ex)
alchemy.desc: A practiced hand with venoms and toxins, this character can brew, apply, and harvest poison without risk of self-poisoning. Their doses are potent and their formulae closely guarded.

alchemy.name: Infused Extracts (Su)
alchemy.desc: You infuse reagents into single-use extracts that mimic minor spells, stored in vials only you can trigger. Each morning you prepare a number of doses equal to half your character level (minimum 1); each dose duplicates a 1st- or 2nd-level alchemist extract of your choice at a caster level equal to your character level.

alchemy.name: Caustic Flask (Ex)
alchemy.desc: This character carries flasks of clinging acid and alchemical fire, lobbed with practiced accuracy at exposed foes. Their splashes find the seams in armor and burn through with corrosive precision.

contextNotes.text: +{half_level} damage with thrown alchemical splash weapons

alchemy.name: Greater Bombs & Discoveries (Su)
alchemy.desc: Your bombs improve and you learn two discoveries (such as explosive bomb, frost bomb, or stink bomb). You are immune to poison, and you can apply poison to a weapon without risk of poisoning yourself.

alchemy.name: Refined Mutagen (Su)
alchemy.desc: You distill a potent mutagen that reshapes flesh and bone. A number of times per day equal to one-third your character level (minimum 1) you can drink one as a standard action; for 10 minutes per level it grants a +6 alchemical bonus to one physical ability score and a +4 natural armor bonus, at the cost of a -2 penalty to a mental ability score.

alchemy.name: Master Bomber (Su)
alchemy.desc: You hurl bombs laced with frost, lightning, or clinging fire. A number of times per day equal to your character level + your Intelligence modifier you can throw a bomb (ranged touch attack, range 20 ft.) that deals 1d6 fire damage per two character levels plus your Intelligence modifier on a direct hit and an extra amount of damage equal to your character level; creatures in adjacent squares take splash damage equal to the minimum.

contextNotes.text: +{level} damage with thrown bombs and splash weapons

alchemy.name: Discovery of the Tireless Flask (Su)
alchemy.desc: Through esoteric discoveries, this character coaxes effects from their reagents that defy mundane chemistry, brewing extracts that fly, heal, or wreathe a weapon in alchemical flame. Their craft borders on the magical.

alchemy.name: Grand Alchemy (Su)
alchemy.desc: Once per day you can drink a grand mutagen granting a +8 alchemical bonus to one physical ability score and +6 natural armor. You also gain a grand discovery such as fast healing 5 while a mutagen is active, or an awakened intellect that grants a +2 inherent bonus to Intelligence.

alchemy.name: Philosopher's Apotheosis (Su)
alchemy.desc: A grandmaster of the alchemical arts, you brew elixirs of life, true mutagens, and bombs that rival a wizard's fire. A number of times per day equal to your character level + your Intelligence modifier you can throw a perfected bomb dealing 1d6 fire damage per two character levels plus your Intelligence modifier plus an extra amount equal to your character level; against such alchemical effects the target is treated as flat-footed and is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC.

contextNotes.text: +{level} damage with bombs; alchemical effects treat targets as flat-footed

skill.name: Quick Study (Ex)
skill.desc: You pick up the tricks of any trade. You gain a +1 bonus on two skills associated with your profession, and you can attempt those skills untrained.

skill.name: Light Fingers (Ex)
skill.desc: A lifetime of palming coins and lifting purses makes petty theft second nature. The {class} gains a +2 circumstance bonus on Sleight of Hand checks.

skill.name: Shifty Eyes (Ex)
skill.desc: Always watching for marks and witnesses, the {class} notices the small things others miss. They gain a +2 competence bonus on Perception checks.

skill.name: Persuasive (Ex)
skill.desc: You sway attitudes and intimidate with ease. You gain a +2 bonus on Diplomacy and Intimidate checks; if you have 10 or more ranks in either skill, that bonus increases to +4 for it.

skill.name: Loaded Dice (Ex)
skill.desc: The {class} keeps weighted dice and marked cards close at hand, and knows how to slip them into play. They gain a +3 circumstance bonus on Sleight of Hand checks made to cheat at games of chance and on Bluff checks to avoid being caught doing so.

contextNotes.text: +3 circumstance on Bluff to hide cheating at games of chance

skill.name: Cutpurse Reflexes (Ex)
skill.desc: Quick hands and quicker feet keep the {class} one step ahead of an angry crowd. They gain a +2 competence bonus on Initiative checks.

skill.name: Sneak Attack +1d6 (Ex)
skill.desc: When you catch a foe flat-footed or flanked, your precise strikes deal an extra 1d6 points of damage.

contextNotes.text: +1d6 sneak attack vs flat-footed or flanked foes

skill.name: Weaponized Words (Ex)
skill.desc: You can use the Bluff skill to feint and demoralize in combat. Once per day you can plant a damaging quip that leaves a foe within 30 feet shaken for 1 minute (Will negates, DC 10 + half your level + your Charisma modifier).

skill.name: Trap Sense (Ex)
skill.desc: Years spent prying open locks and probing for needle-traps grant an instinct for hidden danger. The {class} gains a +2 dodge bonus to AC against attacks from traps and a +2 insight bonus on Reflex saves to avoid them.

contextNotes.text: +2 dodge to AC vs. traps
+2 insight on Reflex saves to avoid traps

skill.name: Silver Tongue (Ex)
skill.desc: The {class} talks their way out of trouble as easily as into a stranger's confidence. They gain a +3 competence bonus on Bluff and Diplomacy checks.

skill.name: Roguish Talents (Ex)
skill.desc: Your sneak attack improves to +3d6, and you gain evasion and uncanny dodge (you take no damage on a successful Reflex save against effects that allow half, and you keep your Dexterity bonus to AC against unseen attackers).

contextNotes.text: +3d6 sneak attack vs flat-footed or flanked foes

skill.name: Inspiring Performance (Su)
skill.desc: You can perform to inspire your allies a number of rounds per day equal to 4 + your Charisma modifier. While performing, allies who can hear you gain a +2 morale bonus on attack and weapon damage rolls and on saves against fear and charm.

skill.name: Evasion (Ex)
skill.desc: The {class} can twist aside from area effects with a thief's reflexes. Whenever they succeed on a Reflex save against an effect that deals half damage on a success, they instead take no damage.

skill.name: Ghost in the Crowd (Ex)
skill.desc: The {class} vanishes into shadow and bustle at will, slipping a tail or fading from sight mid-conversation. A number of times per day equal to half their level (minimum 1), they may make a Stealth check to hide even while being observed, with a +4 circumstance bonus.

skill.name: Improved Sneak Attack +2d6 (Ex)
skill.desc: The {class} unerringly finds the gaps in an enemy's guard. When they catch a foe flat-footed or flanked, their attacks deal an extra 2d6 precision damage.

skill.name: Master of Disguise (Ex)
skill.desc: You can disguise yourself as a full-round action with a +10 bonus, and you gain a +5 competence bonus on Bluff and Stealth checks. Once per day you can read a creature's surface thoughts (as detect thoughts, caster level equal to your character level) by conversing with it for 1 minute.

skill.name: Uncanny Dodge (Ex)
skill.desc: The {class} reacts to danger before their senses fully register it, never letting a hidden blade find an easy mark. They retain their Dexterity bonus to AC even when caught flat-footed or struck by an unseen attacker, and cannot be flanked except by a rogue of higher level.

skill.name: Deadly Ambush +3d6 (Ex)
skill.desc: A master of the killing strike from darkness, the {class} turns a single moment of surprise into a mortal wound. Against flat-footed or flanked foes their precision damage rises by 3d6, and a creature struck during a surprise round must succeed on a Fortitude save (DC 10 + {half_level} + the {class}'s Dexterity modifier) or be staggered for 1 round.

skill.name: Living Legend (Ex)
skill.desc: Your reputation bends fate. Once per day you may reroll any d20 roll and take the better result. You add your Charisma modifier as a luck bonus on all saving throws, and you may take 10 on any skill check even under duress. Your sneak attack increases to +5d6 and you gain improved evasion.

contextNotes.text: +5d6 sneak attack vs flat-footed or flanked foes

skill.name: Phantom Thief (Ex)
skill.desc: The {class} is a legend among criminals, said to walk through locked vaults and steal the rings from a king's fingers. Once per day they may treat a single Stealth, Sleight of Hand, Disable Device, or Disguise check as if they had rolled a natural 20, and bystanders never recall having seen them.

craft.name: Skilled Hands (Ex)
craft.desc: Years at the workbench steady your hands. You gain a +2 bonus on your primary Craft or Profession skill and you can always take 10 on it, even when distracted.

craft.name: Patient Mender (Ex)
craft.desc: Given 1 hour and any scrap materials at hand, you can repair a broken (but not destroyed) object, restoring it to working order; the repair lasts 24 hours before the object becomes broken again unless properly fixed. Once per day this same repair can instead be permanent. You also gain a +2 competence bonus on Craft checks made to repair items.

craft.name: Calloused Grip (Ex)
craft.desc: Years at the bench and forge have hardened your hands against splinters, sparks, and burns. You gain a +1 competence bonus on Craft checks, and you take no penalty on Craft or Profession checks made while working in hazardous conditions such as a hot forge, a rocking ship, or extreme cold.

craft.name: Master Craftsman (Ex)
craft.desc: You can use your Craft or Profession ranks in place of the caster-level prerequisite for item creation feats, and you craft masterwork goods in half the normal time and cost.

craft.name: Sturdy Workbench (Ex)
craft.desc: With a proper bench, vise, and your own tools, you work without error. You gain a +2 competence bonus on Craft checks, and whenever you fail a Craft check by less than 5 while at your workbench, you do not ruin the raw materials.

craft.name: Honest Materials (Ex)
craft.desc: Objects you craft gain hardness equal to half your ranks in the relevant Craft skill (minimum +1) and +2 hit points per inch of thickness. Once per day you can spend 1 minute reinforcing a held object to grant it this same benefit for 24 hours.

craft.name: Field Repair (Ex)
craft.desc: You gain a +4 competence bonus on Craft checks and can repair damaged gear or improvise tools in 1d4 minutes rather than hours. Once per day you can spend 1 minute to restore a broken item to full working order.

craft.name: Quality Goods (Ex)
craft.desc: Your wares command a premium. You earn your full Profession check result in gold pieces per week, and you gain a +2 bonus on Appraise checks.

craft.name: Tireless at the Forge (Ex)
craft.desc: The {class} can work a full day and night without faltering, completing in hours what takes lesser hands days. Treat the value of goods this {class} crafts each day as if a full week of labor had passed.

craft.name: Whetstone Master (Ex)
craft.desc: You spend 1 minute tending a weapon or suit of armor; for the next 24 hours its wielder gains a +1 competence bonus on weapon damage rolls (weapon) or a +1 competence bonus to AC against the first attack each round (armor). You can maintain a number of pieces of gear this way equal to your ranks in the relevant Craft skill at one time.

contextNotes.text: Allies wielding gear you tended for 1 minute gain +1 competence to damage (weapon) or AC (armor) for 24 hours.

craft.name: Resourceful Tinker (Ex)
craft.desc: A number of times per day equal to 1 + one quarter your character level (minimum 1) you can spend 10 minutes to improvise a masterwork artisan's tool, a working lock, or a replacement part from scrap and salvage.

craft.name: Artisan's Eye (Ex)
craft.desc: The campaign treats your crafting mastery as eight levels higher. You gain a +4 bonus on Appraise and can identify the maker, materials, and magical aura of any crafted object you study for 1 minute.

craft.name: Siege Engineer (Ex)
craft.desc: You are proficient with all siege weapons and can build or repair them at half cost and time. You gain a +4 bonus on attack rolls and to aim siege engines, and you can jury-rig traps and barricades during a short rest.

craft.name: Guild Hallmark (Ex)
craft.desc: You stamp every finished piece with a renowned maker's mark. You gain a +4 competence bonus on Craft checks, and goods bearing your hallmark sell for 1-1/2 times their normal price (a +2 circumstance bonus on Profession checks to earn income from selling your own wares).

craft.name: Runesmith's Touch (Sp)
craft.desc: Once per day you can spend 1 minute etching a functional rune into a mundane item you made, granting it a temporary magic property for 10 minutes: a weapon gains a +1 enhancement bonus, a suit of armor gains a +1 enhancement bonus, or a tool grants a +2 competence bonus on checks made with it.

craft.name: Legendary Artisan (Su)
craft.desc: You craft magic items as though you possessed every item creation feat, using a caster level equal to your Craft or Profession ranks. Once per day you can spend 1 minute to imbue an item you have made with a temporary +1 enhancement bonus for 1 hour.

craft.name: Flawless Assembly (Ex)
craft.desc: Everything you build is automatically of masterwork quality at no extra cost or time. Objects you craft gain hardness +5 and double their normal hit points, and gain a +5 bonus to their break DC and to CMD against sunder attempts.

craft.name: Soulforged Implements (Su)
craft.desc: You can spend 8 hours binding a weapon or tool you forged to a single creature. While that creature wields the bound implement, it gains a +1 competence bonus on attack rolls made with it (weapon) or a +2 competence bonus on skill checks made with it (tool). You can have one such implement bound at a time.

contextNotes.text: +1 competence to attack rolls made with a weapon you forged and bound to its wielder.

craft.name: Grandmaster's Output (Ex)
craft.desc: You run a workshop of apprentices that produces goods at a guild's pace. You gain a +6 competence bonus on Craft checks, and you treat each day of crafting as if a full week of labor had passed when calculating the value of goods completed.

craft.name: Masterwork of Ages (Su)
craft.desc: You can create a single legendary masterwork, treating your effective caster level as your ranks + 5 and ignoring half the normal gp cost. Gear you personally craft grants its wielder a +2 competence bonus on checks made with it, and your finest creation counts as an artifact for the purpose of resisting destruction.

craft.name: Worldforger (Su)
craft.desc: The {class} crafts wonders thought lost to legend, shaping metal and stone as easily as a potter shapes clay. Given materials and a forge, they can produce magic arms, armor, and wondrous items as though possessed of every relevant item-creation art.

scholar.name: Bookish (Ex)
scholar.desc: Years buried in dusty tomes let you read and write any language you know and grant a +2 competence bonus on Linguistics checks and on any one Knowledge skill in which you have at least 1 rank. Once per day you may take 20 on a Knowledge or Linguistics check made to research a written record without spending extra time.

scholar.name: Footnote Hoarder (Ex)
scholar.desc: You obsessively annotate every margin and cross-reference the most obscure citations. You gain a +2 competence bonus on Linguistics checks, and once per day you may reroll a single failed Linguistics check and take the better result.

scholar.name: Idle Speculation (Ex)
scholar.desc: Your endless musing about history and rumor makes you a font of half-remembered lore. You gain a +2 competence bonus on Knowledge (history) and Knowledge (local) checks, and once per day you may make a Knowledge check to recall a relevant fact even for a topic in which you have no ranks, treating it as a trained check.

scholar.name: Lore Master (Ex)
scholar.desc: You gain a +2 bonus on all Knowledge checks and can always take 10 on them. You can attempt any Knowledge check untrained.

scholar.name: Polyglot's Ear (Ex)
scholar.desc: Hours of study across foreign grammars let you puzzle out unfamiliar speech and script. You gain a +2 competence bonus on Linguistics checks, and you can read a message in a language you do not know, or decipher an unfamiliar cipher, with a Linguistics check (DC 10 + half your character level + your Intelligence modifier).

scholar.name: Encyclopedic Recall (Ex)
scholar.desc: Your memory is a well-ordered archive of names, dates, and minor facts. You gain a +2 competence bonus on all Knowledge checks, and you can attempt any Knowledge check untrained to recall an obscure fact.

scholar.name: Bardic Knowledge (Ex)
scholar.desc: You add half your character level (minimum 1) to all Knowledge checks, and you can identify a creature's abilities and weaknesses as a free action on a successful check.

scholar.name: Measured Counsel (Ex)
scholar.desc: You weigh every consequence with a calm, analytic mind before acting. You add your Intelligence modifier as an insight bonus on initiative checks. As a standard action you may grant one ally who can hear you a +2 insight bonus on their next attack roll, saving throw, or skill check, made before the end of their next turn.

scholar.name: Marginalia of the Masters (Ex)
scholar.desc: Having transcribed the working notes of long-dead sages, you apply their insights broadly. You gain a +1 competence bonus on Knowledge (arcana), Knowledge (geography), and Knowledge (history) checks, and once per day you may spend 1 minute consulting your notes to gain a +5 competence bonus on a single Knowledge check.

scholar.name: Cross-Referenced Mind (Ex)
scholar.desc: This scholar links scattered facts into a single coherent web of understanding, recalling the right detail at the right moment. Once per day they may declare that they have studied the matter before and treat a single Knowledge check as if they had taken 20.

scholar.name: Forbidden Lore (Sp)
scholar.desc: You can cast comprehend languages, detect thoughts, and see invisibility, each twice per day as spell-like abilities (caster level equal to your character level).

scholar.name: Battle Tactician (Ex)
scholar.desc: Your study of warfare pays off. As a standard action you can study a foe to grant yourself and allies who can hear you a +1 insight bonus on attack rolls against it for 1 minute, and you gain a +4 bonus on a Knowledge check to identify it.

scholar.name: Annotated Stratagem (Ex)
scholar.desc: Drawing on treatises of war and rhetoric, you pick apart an opponent's method. A number of times per day equal to one quarter your character level (minimum 1) you may study a foe as a standard action; for {level} rounds, you and allies within 30 feet who can hear you gain a +2 insight bonus on attack rolls against that foe.

contextNotes.text: Allies gain +2 insight on attacks against the studied foe.

scholar.name: Oracle of Footnotes (Sp)
scholar.desc: By consulting the accumulated wisdom of ages, you divine answers to pressing questions. A number of times per day equal to 1 + your Intelligence modifier you may cast augury or divination as a spell-like ability (caster level equal to your character level).

scholar.name: Sage's Insight (Sp)
scholar.desc: Once per day you can perform a legend lore-style divination, and your foresight grants a +2 insight bonus on initiative and prevents you from being caught flat-footed. Once per day you may cast a 3rd-level divination spell (such as arcane sight or speak with dead) as a spell-like ability.

scholar.name: Mentor's Clarity (Ex)
scholar.desc: A lifetime of teaching lets you break any problem into solvable steps and share that clarity. You and allies within 30 feet who can hear you gain a +2 insight bonus on all saving throws.

scholar.name: Reader of Omens (Sp)
scholar.desc: You perceive the threads of fate woven through history and the present moment. A number of times per day equal to one third your character level (minimum 1) you may cast locate object, tongues, or commune as a spell-like ability (caster level equal to your character level).

scholar.name: Perfect Memorization (Ex)
scholar.desc: Nothing you read or witness is ever truly forgotten. You add your Intelligence modifier as an insight bonus on Linguistics checks, you may recall any specific detail you have personally seen or read without a check, and you may always take 10 on Knowledge and Linguistics checks even when distracted or threatened.

scholar.name: Living Library (Sp)
scholar.desc: Your mind holds the knowledge of an age. Once per day you can learn the answer to a single question as if by commune. You gain a +4 insight bonus on all saving throws against mind-affecting effects, and once per day you may cast a 6th-level knowledge or divination spell (such as legend lore or true seeing on all allies) as a spell-like ability.

scholar.name: Keeper of the Unwritten Word (Sp)
scholar.desc: You have internalized lore that no library dares record. A number of times per day equal to 3 + your Intelligence modifier you may cast legend lore, scrying, or vision as a spell-like ability, and once per day you may cast true seeing to pierce any deception (caster level equal to your character level).

nature.name: Wild Empathy (Ex)
nature.desc: You can improve the attitude of animals as you would influence a person, and you gain a +2 bonus on Survival checks and to track.

nature.name: Weather Sense (Ex)
nature.desc: You read wind, cloud, and pressure to predict the coming day's weather automatically. You gain a +2 competence bonus on Survival checks, and once per day you may take 10 minutes to study the sky and grant yourself and all allies within 30 feet a +2 competence bonus on saving throws against weather and natural environmental hazards (such as storms, extreme heat or cold, and avalanches) for the next 24 hours.

nature.name: Forager's Eye (Ex)
nature.desc: You unfailingly find food, clean water, and firewood in the wild. You gain a +2 competence bonus on Survival checks, and after 1 hour of foraging you automatically provide enough food and water to sustain a number of Medium creatures equal to your Survival ranks for one day.

nature.name: Beast Soother (Ex)
nature.desc: A calm word and a steady hand settle skittish animals. You gain a +2 competence bonus on Handle Animal checks, and you may attempt to influence the attitude of an animal as a Diplomacy check using your Handle Animal modifier.

nature.name: Trail Reader (Ex)
nature.desc: You spot broken twigs, faint prints, and disturbed earth that others miss. You gain a +2 competence bonus on Survival checks, including checks made to follow tracks, and you can move at your normal speed while tracking without taking the usual -5 penalty.

nature.name: Sea Legs (Ex)
nature.desc: Long voyages have given you flawless balance aboard a pitching deck. You gain a +2 competence bonus on Swim checks and a +2 competence bonus on Acrobatics checks made to keep your balance on unstable or moving surfaces, and you are never sickened by motion or seasickness.

nature.name: Favored Terrain (Ex)
nature.desc: Choose one type of terrain. While in it you gain a +2 bonus on initiative and on Knowledge (geography), Perception, Stealth, and Survival checks, and you leave no trail and cannot be tracked unless you choose.

contextNotes.text: +2 initiative in favored terrain

nature.name: Animal Companion (Ex)
nature.desc: You gain a loyal animal companion that advances as that of a druid of a level equal to half your character level (minimum 1).

nature.name: Woodland Stride (Ex)
nature.desc: The character moves through undergrowth, thorns, and natural difficult terrain at full speed, leaving the brush undisturbed behind them.

contextNotes.text: Ignores natural difficult terrain when moving

nature.name: Favored Enemy (Ex)
nature.desc: Choose one creature type. You gain a +2 bonus on attack and weapon damage rolls against such creatures and a +4 bonus on Bluff, Knowledge, Perception, Sense Motive, and Survival checks regarding them.

contextNotes.text: +2 attack and damage vs favored enemy

nature.name: Hunter's Stride (Ex)
nature.desc: You move through natural difficult terrain at full speed and without leaving a trail, and in any natural terrain you can use Stealth even while being observed (hide in plain sight), gaining a +4 bonus on Stealth checks outdoors.

nature.name: Pack Bond (Ex)
nature.desc: You fight in concert with a trained beast, the two of you flanking and protecting one another. While you are adjacent to your animal companion or mount, you gain a +1 untyped bonus on attack rolls and a +1 dodge bonus to AC.

contextNotes.text: +1 attack and +1 dodge AC while adjacent to your animal companion or mount

nature.name: Camouflage (Ex)
nature.desc: Smearing mud and weaving foliage into your gear, you all but vanish into the wild. You gain a +4 competence bonus on Stealth checks, and while in any natural terrain you can use Stealth even with no cover or concealment.

nature.name: Nature's Casting (Sp)
nature.desc: You channel the wild like a 4th-level druid. You can cast entangle, barkskin, and summon nature's ally II as spell-like abilities (caster level equal to your character level); the total number of such castings each day equals 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

nature.name: Venom Immunity (Ex)
nature.desc: A lifetime among serpents, spiders, and toxic flora has hardened your body. You are immune to all poison, regardless of its source or type.

nature.name: Endure Elements (Su)
nature.desc: The wild's harshest extremes leave you unbothered. You take no harm from severe heat or cold (between -50 and 140 degrees Fahrenheit), and you gain a +2 resistance bonus on Fortitude saves against weather, environmental hazards, and energy damage from heat or cold.

nature.name: Thousand Faces (Su)
nature.desc: Channeling the shifting nature of the wild, you can alter your physical appearance at will as an alter self spell (caster level equal to your character level). You may change your form a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier, and each change lasts until you dismiss it or change again.

nature.name: One With the Wild (Su)
nature.desc: Once per day you can assume the form of a powerful beast (as beast shape III) for 1 hour. You gain DR 5/magic against natural creatures, immunity to natural environmental hazards, and the ability to speak with and command animals at will.

nature.name: Verdant Renewal (Su)
nature.desc: You are so attuned to living things that the wild mends you in turn. As a swift action while in a natural environment you can begin regaining hit points equal to half your character level (minimum 1) at the start of each of your turns for 1 minute. You can activate this a number of times per day equal to one quarter your character level (minimum 1).

nature.name: Master of the Wild Hunt (Su)
nature.desc: You command the beasts of the land as a king commands subjects. Once per use you can spend a full-round action to summon 1d4+1 animals (as summon nature's ally V, caster level equal to your character level) that obey your commands for 1 minute per character level; while these beasts are present you and they gain a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls. You can use this a number of times per day equal to one fifth your character level (minimum 1).

medical.name: Field Medic (Ex)
medical.desc: You gain a +4 bonus on Heal checks, can treat deadly wounds without a healer's kit, and grant a +2 bonus when stabilizing the dying.

medical.name: Bedside Manner (Ex)
medical.desc: Your calm, reassuring presence soothes the suffering. You gain a +2 competence bonus on Heal checks and on Diplomacy checks made to comfort or treat a patient.

medical.name: Splint and Salve (Ex)
medical.desc: You can set a broken bone or bind a wound with whatever is at hand. You can provide long-term care and treat caltrops, deadly wounds, and similar injuries without a healer's kit, and a creature you treat heals 1 extra hit point per day of rest.

medical.name: Steady Hands (Ex)
medical.desc: Years of delicate work have given you unflinching control. You gain a +3 competence bonus on Heal checks, and you never take a penalty on Heal checks for working in poor conditions or under duress.

medical.name: Disease Ward (Ex)
medical.desc: Constant exposure to contagion has toughened your constitution. You gain a +2 resistance bonus on Fortitude saves against disease, poison, and nausea.

contextNotes.text: +2 vs disease, poison, and nausea

medical.name: Battlefield Surgeon (Ex)
medical.desc: You work fast under fire. You can treat deadly wounds or stabilize a dying creature as a standard action rather than a full round, and on a successful Heal check a creature you stabilize regains 1 hit point.

medical.name: Healer's Touch (Sp)
medical.desc: You can cast cure light wounds three times per day as a spell-like ability, and you can remove the fatigued, shaken, or sickened condition from a creature by touch (caster level equal to your character level).

medical.name: Poultice Maker (Sp)
medical.desc: You can prepare a healing poultice that, when applied as a standard action, acts as cure light wounds (caster level equal to your character level). You can apply such a poultice a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

medical.name: Triage (Ex)
medical.desc: You instantly assess the wounded. As a swift action you can tell the exact remaining hit points and conditions of any creature you can see, and once per round you may grant an ally within 30 feet a number of temporary hit points equal to half your level (minimum 1).

medical.name: Antivenom Expert (Sp)
medical.desc: You have a near-perfect understanding of toxins. You can cast delay poison at will on touch, and once per day each you can cast lesser restoration and remove sickness as spell-like abilities (caster level equal to your character level).

medical.name: Chirurgeon (Su)
medical.desc: A number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier you can, by touch, heal 1 point of ability damage, cure a disease, or neutralize a poison. You gain a +2 bonus on all Heal checks.

medical.name: Anatomist (Ex)
medical.desc: As a move action you can study a living creature's anatomy; your attacks against it deal an extra 1d6 precision damage for 1 minute. You can use this on a number of creatures at once equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1).

medical.name: Field Amputation (Ex)
medical.desc: You can halt even mortal bleeding. As a standard action you automatically end any bleed effect, ongoing damage, or the dying condition on a creature you touch, and that creature is healed 1d8 + your level hit points. You can do this 3 + your Wisdom modifier times per day.

medical.name: Plague Doctor (Sp)
medical.desc: Disease holds no terror for you. You are immune to disease, and once per day each you can cast remove disease and cure moderate wounds as spell-like abilities (caster level equal to your character level).

medical.name: Master Physician (Sp)
medical.desc: Once per day each you can cast lesser restoration, remove disease, and neutralize poison as spell-like abilities, and once per day you can cast breath of life to revive a creature that died within the last round (caster level equal to your character level).

medical.name: Vital Surgeon (Su)
medical.desc: Your surgery borders on the miraculous. A number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier you can spend 1 minute operating on a willing or helpless creature to restore 1d8 hit points per two character levels and remove one negative level, disease, or 1d4 points of ability damage.

medical.name: Restorer of the Crippled (Sp)
medical.desc: You mend what others cannot. Once per day each you can cast restoration, remove blindness/deafness, and remove paralysis as spell-like abilities (caster level equal to your character level), and your Heal checks count as a full week of long-term care in a single day.

medical.name: Surgeon's Insight (Ex)
medical.desc: Your intimate knowledge of anatomy sharpens every cut. You gain a +1 insight bonus on attack rolls, and your melee attacks against living creatures deal an extra 2d6 precision damage.

medical.name: Miracle Worker (Sp)
medical.desc: You hold death at bay. Once per day you can cast raise dead as a spell-like ability. Allies within 30 feet of you gain fast healing 2, and you are immune to disease and to death effects and energy drain.

medical.name: Mender of Souls (Sp)
medical.desc: Your healing transcends the body. Once per day you can cast regenerate or heal as a spell-like ability (caster level equal to your character level), and a number of times per day equal to your Wisdom modifier you can cast cure serious wounds. Creatures you heal are also cured of fear and confusion.

menial.name: Pool Cleaner (Ex)
menial.desc: A lifetime in the muck has left its mark. You gain a +10 bonus on Swim checks and on a single cleaning-related Profession or Craft check, and years of exposure have made you immune to poison.

menial.name: Gongfarmer's Constitution (Ex)
menial.desc: Nothing foul can turn your stomach. You are immune to disease and to the sickened and nauseated conditions caused by filth or stench, you gain a +4 bonus on saves against ingested poison, and you can eat or drink almost anything without harm.

menial.name: Beneath Notice (Ex)
menial.desc: You are just another pair of hands in the crowd. You gain a +2 competence bonus on Stealth checks in any settled or working area, and you may use Stealth to blend into a crowd or busy workplace even while being directly observed.

menial.name: Tireless Drudge (Ex)
menial.desc: Endless labor has hardened you. You ignore fatigue caused by physical work, gain a +4 bonus on saves and checks to resist exhaustion, and can carry 25% more weight before becoming encumbered.

menial.name: Hardened Hands (Ex)
menial.desc: A lifetime of rope, shovel, and bucket has turned your hands to leather. You gain a +2 bonus on Climb checks and on combat maneuver checks to maintain a grapple, and you cannot be disarmed of a simple tool or weapon you hold.

menial.name: Beast of Burden (Ex)
menial.desc: You haul loads that would break a lesser back. You treat your Strength as +4 higher for determining carrying capacity, and you take no penalty to speed while carrying a medium load.

menial.name: Invisible Servant (Ex)
menial.desc: People overlook the help. You gain a +4 bonus on Stealth checks while performing menial work in plain sight, and you routinely overhear what you should not, gaining a +4 bonus on a single Perception or social skill to catch and recall secrets.

menial.name: Gutter Survivor (Ex)
menial.desc: You have slept in alleys and eaten what others threw away. You gain a +4 bonus on Survival checks to get along in a settlement and on saves against starvation, thirst, and harsh weather, and you always know where to find shelter in a city.

menial.name: Stink of the Trade (Ex)
menial.desc: The reek of your labor clings to you and keeps predators away. Animals and scent-based creatures take a -4 penalty on checks to track you by smell, and you gain a +2 bonus on saves against inhaled poisons and stench effects.

contextNotes.text: +2 vs inhaled poison and stench

menial.name: Pack Mule's Footing (Ex)
menial.desc: Years of hauling on slick floors and crumbling ledges keep you upright. You gain a +4 bonus to CMD against trip and bull rush, and you ignore difficult terrain caused by rubble, mud, or refuse.

menial.name: Filth-Forged Hide (Ex)
menial.desc: Scrubbed raw and toughened by toil, your skin shrugs off scrapes and grime alike. You gain a +1 natural armor bonus to AC, and you are immune to disease and to the nauseated condition.

menial.name: Drudge's Endurance (Ex)
menial.desc: You labor long past where others collapse. You gain Endurance and Diehard as bonus feats, you can work or march twice as long before checking for fatigue, and you need only half the normal sleep to recover.

menial.name: Overlooked Witness (Ex)
menial.desc: Hidden in plain sight, you see and hear everything the masters say in front of the help. You gain a +4 bonus on Perception and Sense Motive checks while at menial work, and you can recall any overheard detail as if you had aided yourself on a Knowledge (local) check.

menial.name: Iron Gut (Ex)
menial.desc: Decades of spoiled rations and tainted water have made your innards indestructible. You are immune to ingested poison and disease, you suffer no ill effect from rotten or contaminated food and drink, and you may eat almost any organic matter as nourishment.

menial.name: Unbreakable Back (Ex)
menial.desc: Toil has tempered your body into something that simply will not quit. You gain DR 2/— against nonlethal damage, you are immune to fatigue and exhaustion, and once per day when reduced below 0 hit points you stabilize automatically and remain conscious for 1 round.

menial.name: The Help Always Survives (Ex)
menial.desc: The lowly outlast the mighty. Once per day, when an effect would reduce you to 0 or fewer hit points, you are instead left at 1 hit point and may take a single move action. You are immune to poison, disease, and energy drain, and you gain a +4 bonus on saves against death effects.

performance.name: Open Mic Regular (Ex)
performance.desc: You haunt every tavern stage that will have you. You gain a +1 competence bonus on Perform checks, and once per day you can perform for 1 hour to earn 1d4 copper pieces and learn one current local rumor from the audience.

performance.name: Off-Key Carouser (Ex)
performance.desc: You sing loudly and badly, but you read a room well enough to make friends anywhere. You gain a +1 competence bonus on Diplomacy checks, and once per day you may reroll a failed Diplomacy check to improve the attitude of a creature in a tavern, feast, or other social gathering.

performance.name: Tip Jar Hustler (Ex)
performance.desc: A wink, a flourish, and an outstretched hat earn you coin from passersby. Once per day you can spend 10 minutes busking with a Perform check; you earn gold equal to your Perform ranks × 5 silver pieces (minimum 5 sp) on a check of DC 10 or higher, plus an additional 5 sp for every 5 by which you beat that DC.

performance.name: Crowd-Pleaser (Ex)
performance.desc: You have a knack for playing to whatever audience is in front of you. You gain a +2 competence bonus on Perform checks to entertain a crowd.

performance.name: Cutting Wit (Ex)
performance.desc: Your barbed jokes find their mark. You gain a +2 competence bonus on Intimidate checks made to demoralize a foe who can hear and understand you.

performance.name: Quick Curtsy (Ex)
performance.desc: A practiced bow or pirouette keeps you light on your feet under the stage lights. You gain a +2 competence bonus on Acrobatics checks.

performance.name: Inspiring Refrain (Su)
performance.desc: When you raise your voice in song, your companions take heart. While you perform, allies who can hear you gain a +1 morale bonus on attack rolls.

contextNotes.text: +1 morale on attacks while you perform for them

performance.name: Fascinating Flourish (Sp)
performance.desc: With a hypnotic gesture and a lilting tune you can rivet a creature's attention. A number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier, as a standard action you can target one creature within 30 feet that can see and hear you; unless it succeeds on a Will save (DC 10 + half your character level + your Charisma modifier) it is fascinated for as long as you continue a Perform action, up to 1 round per character level.

performance.name: Heckler's Tongue (Ex)
performance.desc: Years of trading insults from the stage have honed your tongue to a razor. You gain a +3 competence bonus on Intimidate checks.

performance.name: Local Celebrity (Ex)
performance.desc: Your name is known in every alehouse and market square for a day's ride. You gain a +3 competence bonus on Diplomacy checks to gather information or sway those who recognize your reputation.

performance.name: Stirring Anthem (Su)
performance.desc: Your rousing performance steels the resolve of those around you. Allies who can hear your song gain a +2 morale bonus on saving throws against fear and charm effects while you perform.

contextNotes.text: +2 morale vs fear/charm while you perform for them

performance.name: Mocking Tirade (Su)
performance.desc: You unleash a withering stream of mockery that throws an enemy off balance. A number of times per day equal to 1 + your Charisma modifier (minimum 1), as a standard action you target one foe within 30 feet that can hear and understand you; unless it succeeds on a Will save (DC 10 + half your character level + your Charisma modifier) it takes a -2 penalty on attack rolls and on saving throws for 3 rounds.

performance.name: Dazzling Display (Ex)
performance.desc: You blend swordplay and showmanship into one breathtaking routine. You gain a +2 competence bonus on attack rolls during the round you spend a full action on a flourishing performance.

contextNotes.text: +2 competence on attacks the round after a dazzling flourish

performance.name: Captivating Presence (Ex)
performance.desc: All eyes turn to you the moment you take the floor. You gain a +4 competence bonus on Perform checks and on Diplomacy checks to make a first impression.

performance.name: Battle Hymn (Su)
performance.desc: Your soaring battle-song drives allies to greater fury. While you perform, allies who can hear you gain a +2 morale bonus on weapon damage rolls.

contextNotes.text: +2 morale on damage while you perform for them

performance.name: Spellbinding Recital (Sp)
performance.desc: Your storytelling weaves an almost magical thrall over your audience. Once per day you can hold one listening creature within 30 feet spellbound as the suggestion spell (caster level equal to your character level); the target resists with a Will save (DC 10 + half your character level + your Charisma modifier).

performance.name: Renowned Maestro (Ex)
performance.desc: Your fame precedes you into noble courts and crowded plazas alike. You gain a +5 competence bonus on Perform checks and treat your reputation as opening doors normally closed to commoners.

performance.name: Cadence of Heroes (Su)
performance.desc: The rhythm of your performance lifts your companions beyond their limits. Allies who can hear you gain a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls and a +2 morale bonus on Will saves while you perform.

contextNotes.text: +2 morale on attacks while you perform for them
+2 morale on Will saves while you perform for them

performance.name: Legend in the Making (Ex)
performance.desc: Bards across the realm sing of your exploits, and the mere mention of your name moves crowds. You gain a +6 competence bonus on Perform checks and on Diplomacy checks to influence anyone who has heard of you.

performance.name: Symphony of the Vanguard (Su)
performance.desc: Your masterwork performance transforms a ragged band into an unstoppable ensemble of war. While you perform, allies who can hear you gain a +3 morale bonus on attack rolls, weapon damage rolls, and saving throws against fear.

contextNotes.text: +3 morale on attacks while you perform for them
+3 morale on damage while you perform for them
+3 morale vs fear while you perform for them

performance.name: Showstopper's Finale (Sp)
performance.desc: You build to a climax so overwhelming that friend and foe alike are swept up in it. Once per day you can end a performance with a burst of awe: every enemy within 30 feet that can perceive you must succeed on a Will save (DC 10 + half your character level + your Charisma modifier) or be fascinated for 1 round, and all allies within 30 feet who can perceive you gain the benefits of the good hope spell (caster level equal to your character level) for 1 round per character level.

trade.name: Hawker's Patter (Ex)
trade.desc: A lifetime of crying wares in the market square keeps this {class}'s tongue quick and friendly. They take a +1 competence bonus on Bluff checks made to fast-talk a customer.

trade.name: Penny-Pincher (Ex)
trade.desc: Counting coppers all day has made this {class} stingy and sharp-eyed with money. They gain a +1 competence bonus on Appraise checks to estimate the value of common trade goods.

trade.name: Sticky Fingers Warding (Ex)
trade.desc: Years guarding a stall against cutpurses have honed this {class}'s awareness of grasping hands. They take a +1 competence bonus on Sense Motive checks to notice someone casing their goods.

trade.name: Market-Day Haggler (Ex)
trade.desc: This {class} never accepts the first price offered. They gain a +2 competence bonus on Diplomacy checks made to negotiate a price or settle a bargain.

trade.name: Practiced Appraiser (Ex)
trade.desc: A trained eye can weigh a gem or sniff out a forgery at a glance. This {class} takes a +2 competence bonus on Appraise checks.

trade.name: Reading the Mark (Ex)
trade.desc: This {class} sizes up a customer's purse and patience before quoting a price. They gain a +2 competence bonus on Sense Motive checks to gauge a person's wealth, mood, or willingness to buy.

trade.name: Smooth Dealer (Ex)
trade.desc: Few can resist this {class}'s polished sales pitch. They take a +3 competence bonus on Bluff checks made to talk up a deal or downplay a flaw in their wares.

trade.name: Supply Network (Ex)
trade.desc: This {class} keeps a web of suppliers and runners in every town worth visiting. Once per day they may call on a contact to procure, within 1d4 hours, any single mundane item worth up to {level} x 100 gp (priced at standard cost) or one specific piece of local information that an ordinary inquiry could not turn up.

trade.name: Ledger Sense (Ex)
trade.desc: Endless bookkeeping has sharpened this {class}'s grasp of numbers, weights, and routes. They gain a +3 competence bonus on Profession (merchant) checks to run a business or manage cargo.

trade.name: Coin From Wares (Ex)
trade.desc: Wherever this {class} sets up a stall, money follows. Once per week they may spend a day liquidating goods and surplus to gain gold equal to their ranks in Profession (merchant) x 10 (minimum 10 gp).

trade.name: Master Negotiator (Ex)
trade.desc: This {class} can broker a treaty as easily as a sale of grain. They gain a +4 competence bonus on Diplomacy checks made to negotiate terms, prices, or contracts.

trade.name: Calling in Favors (Ex)
trade.desc: This {class} has loaned, lent, and bargained their way into a debt-book of grateful clients. Once per day they may call in a favor from a contact, gaining temporary aid, lodging, hirelings, or guarded passage.

trade.name: Caravan Logistics (Ex)
trade.desc: This {class} can route wagons, hirelings, and pack-beasts with effortless precision. They take a +4 competence bonus on Profession (merchant) checks and on Knowledge (geography) checks to plan trade routes.

trade.name: Counting House Connections (Ex)
trade.desc: This {class}'s name is good at every banking house and trading guild. Once per week they may extend or call in credit to access a lump sum of gold equal to their ranks in Profession (merchant) x 100 (minimum 100 gp) on a day's notice, repaid through future dealings.

trade.name: Honeyed Salesmanship (Ex)
trade.desc: This {class}'s pitch is so persuasive that buyers thank them for the privilege of overpaying. They gain a +5 competence bonus on Bluff checks made to close a sale or misdirect a buyer.

trade.name: Appraiser's Infallible Eye (Ex)
trade.desc: No forgery, fake, or hidden flaw escapes this {class}'s scrutiny. They gain a +5 competence bonus on Appraise checks and can identify the true worth of an item after a moment's handling.

trade.name: Web of Contacts (Ex)
trade.desc: This {class} maintains agents, informants, and partners across the region. A number of times per day equal to 3 + their Charisma modifier they may tap this network to procure a mundane item worth up to {level} x 50 gp, learn one specific piece of regional intelligence, or arrange an introduction to an influential local figure.

trade.name: Trade Empire (Ex)
trade.desc: This {class} commands a sprawling commercial concern whose profits never sleep. Once per week their holdings generate gold equal to their ranks in Profession (merchant) x 200 (minimum 200 gp), and they may draw from their warehouses any mundane goods worth up to that same amount.

trade.name: Merchant Prince's Word (Ex)
trade.desc: This {class}'s reputation moves markets and opens any door that gold can. They gain a +6 competence bonus on Diplomacy checks, and their endorsement alone can sway guilds, nobles, and rival houses.

trade.name: Midas Ledger (Ex)
trade.desc: Wealth flows to this {class} as surely as water runs downhill. Once per month their interlocking ventures, debts owed, and trade monopolies produce gold equal to their character level x 1,000 (minimum 1,000 gp), and place almost any purchasable mundane resource worth up to that amount within reach.

service.name: Clean Apron (Ex)
service.desc: You keep an immaculate station and a ready rag. You gain a +2 competence bonus on Profession (innkeeper, cook, or server) checks and on Diplomacy checks made to wait on or serve a creature, and once per day you can spend 1 minute to clean and press a creature's clothing or your own to grant a +2 circumstance bonus on its next Diplomacy or Disguise check made within 1 hour.

service.name: Free Refill (Ex)
service.desc: A standing pitcher of weak cider is always within reach. Each day you can provide free food and weak drink to a number of creatures equal to your Profession ranks, sparing each a day's ration cost; a creature you serve in this way that then rests for 1 hour removes the fatigued condition. You can grant this fatigue relief to a number of creatures per day equal to 1 + your Charisma modifier (minimum 1).

service.name: Pleasant Greeting (Ex)
service.desc: You welcome each newcomer by name or with a warm word. You gain a +2 competence bonus on Diplomacy checks made to influence a creature within 1 minute of greeting it, and the first such check you make each day may take 10 even if rushed or distracted.

contextNotes.text: +2 competence to Diplomacy within 1 minute of greeting a creature

service.name: Day-Old Bread (Ex)
service.desc: The larder always holds yesterday's loaves and a crock of dripping. A number of times per day equal to 1 + your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) you can provide a free, filling meal to one creature, sparing it a day's ration cost; a creature that eats also removes the fatigued condition.

service.name: Local Gossip (Ex)
service.desc: Behind the bar one hears everything. The character gains a +2 competence bonus on Diplomacy checks to gather information within their own town or district.

contextNotes.text: +2 competence to Diplomacy (gather information) within the home settlement

service.name: Steady Pour (Ex)
service.desc: Years of carrying full trays through crowded rooms have given the character a sure grip and good footing. They gain a +2 competence bonus on Acrobatics checks to move through a crowd or balance.

service.name: Hearty Stew (Ex)
service.desc: A bowl of the house stew puts strength back into tired limbs. A creature that eats for ten minutes removes the fatigued condition; the character can serve this benefit a number of times per day equal to half their level plus their Charisma modifier.

service.name: Honest Welcome (Ex)
service.desc: A reputation for fair dealing precedes this innkeeper. They gain a +2 competence bonus on all Diplomacy checks.

service.name: Larder Keeper (Ex)
service.desc: The pantry is deep and well organized. The character gains a +2 competence bonus on Profession (cook) and Survival checks made to provide food and water for others.

service.name: Warming Hearth (Ex)
service.desc: The common-room fire is kept high and bright, and the character knows how to settle frayed nerves. Allies who rest near them for one hour gain a +1 morale bonus on saves against fear for the next hour.

contextNotes.text: +1 morale vs. fear for one hour after resting an hour by the hearth

service.name: Restorative Brew (Su)
service.desc: Your finest cask carries a touch of restorative magic. A creature that drinks a draught (a standard action) heals hit points as a cure light wounds (1d8 + your level, maximum +5) at a caster level equal to your character level. You can serve this draught a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier.

service.name: Rallying Toast (Su)
service.desc: The host lifts a cup and calls the room to courage. Allies who hear the toast gain a +1 morale bonus on attack rolls, damage, and saves against fear for 1 minute, a number of times per day equal to their Charisma modifier.

contextNotes.text: +1 morale to attack while the toast lasts
+1 morale to damage while the toast lasts
+1 morale vs. fear while the toast lasts

service.name: Well-Connected Host (Ex)
