service.desc: Every traveler, peddler, and courier owes this innkeeper a favor. They gain a +4 competence bonus on Diplomacy checks to gather information and to find someone willing to render a small service.

contextNotes.text: +4 competence to Diplomacy (gather information / call in favors)

service.name: Comfort Food (Su)
service.desc: A warm meal from your hand soothes more than hunger. A creature that eats (a full-round action) removes the shaken or sickened condition and gains a +2 morale bonus on its next saving throw, made before the start of your next turn. You can serve this benefit a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier.

service.name: Feast of Plenty (Su)
service.desc: Once per day the character lays out a magnificent spread, as a heroes' feast shared by all who dine for an hour, save that the number served equals their level. The blessing lasts until the next dawn.

service.name: Master of the House (Ex)
service.desc: Within their own establishment the host commands instant respect and ready aid. They gain a +4 competence bonus on Diplomacy, Sense Motive, and Intimidate checks while on the premises, and always know who has entered.

service.name: Stoke the Common Room (Su)
service.desc: With a roar of song and a round on the house, you whip a crowd into fervor or calm a brewing riot. As a standard action you affect every creature in the room with the equivalent of good hope or calm emotions (your choice) at a caster level equal to your character level. You can do this a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier.

contextNotes.text: +2 morale to attack from good hope while the cheer lasts
+2 morale to damage from good hope while the cheer lasts
+2 morale to saves from good hope while the cheer lasts

service.name: Bottomless Larder (Ex)
service.desc: No matter the season or siege, this kitchen never runs dry. The character can feed and water a small army indefinitely, providing wholesome food and clean drink for dozens of people each day at no cost.

service.name: Legendary Hospitality (Su)
service.desc: To be a guest under your roof is to be truly safe and whole. A creature that lodges and dines for an evening recovers as though from a full day's complete bed rest, removing the fatigued, exhausted, shaken, and frightened conditions and healing extra hit points equal to your character level. You can grant this benefit to a number of creatures per day equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1).

service.name: Ambrosial Banquet (Su)
service.desc: Once per day you lay out a grand banquet that blesses all who partake. Diners who eat for 1 hour gain the benefits of a heroes' feast (caster level equal to your character level) plus a +2 enhancement bonus to one ability score of their choice and immunity to fear and disease until the next dusk.

service.name: Heart of the Hearth (Su)
service.desc: This host is the living soul of their hall, and none who sit at their table despair. Allies within the establishment are continually under the effect of a +2 morale bonus on saves against fear and emotion effects and cannot be made fatigued while they remain and rest.

contextNotes.text: +2 morale vs. fear and emotion effects while within the hall

noble.name: Born to the Manor (Ex)
noble.desc: A lifetime among silk and silver taught you which fork to lift and which lord to flatter. You gain a +2 competence bonus on Diplomacy checks made to influence the attitudes of others.

noble.name: Heraldic Schooling (Ex)
noble.desc: You were tutored in bloodlines, banners, and the politics of every noble house. You gain a +2 competence bonus on Knowledge (nobility) checks.

noble.name: Practiced Disdain (Ex)
noble.desc: A raised eyebrow from your station can wither a commoner's nerve. You gain a +2 competence bonus on Intimidate checks made to demoralize creatures of lower social standing.

noble.name: Voice of Command (Ex)
noble.desc: Years at court honed your charm into a weapon. You gain a +3 competence bonus on Diplomacy checks and may make a request that would normally take 1 minute as a standard action once per round.

noble.name: Bearing of Rank (Ex)
noble.desc: You carry yourself as one who expects to be obeyed. You gain a +1 morale bonus on Will saving throws and a +2 competence bonus on Sense Motive checks to read the intentions of those beneath your station.

noble.name: House Allowance (Ex)
noble.desc: A steady purse from your estate keeps you in fine cloth and ready coin. You begin each adventure with starting wealth equal to 125% of the normal amount, and you may draw on your house's credit to acquire any single mundane item worth up to 100 gp once per week.

noble.name: Retinue (Ex)
noble.desc: You travel attended by loyal servants and a hired guard or two. You command 3 nonheroic followers (such as a valet, a guard, and a runner) who obey your lawful commands, and their presence grants you a +2 circumstance bonus on Diplomacy and Intimidate checks made in their company.

contextNotes.text: +2 circumstance to Diplomacy/Intimidate while your retinue attends you

noble.name: Courtly Intrigue (Ex)
noble.desc: You know how to gather whispers and trade favors. You gain a +3 competence bonus on Knowledge (local) and Knowledge (nobility) checks, and once per day you may call in a favor to learn a single secret or piece of local information as though you had succeeded at a DC 20 Gather Information check.

noble.name: Imperious Command (Ex)
noble.desc: When you speak, allies move. As a standard action you may issue a ringing command to a single willing ally within 30 feet, granting them an immediate move action or a +2 morale bonus on their next attack roll or saving throw. You may use this 3 times per day.

noble.name: Noble Patronage (Ex)
noble.desc: Your name opens doors and loosens guards. In any settlement of town size or larger you are presumed to have lodging, an audience with local officials, and a line of credit worth up to 500 gp, and you gain a +4 circumstance bonus on Diplomacy checks made to requisition aid or hospitality.

noble.name: Aura of Command (Su)
noble.desc: You project the unmistakable authority of a true leader. Allies within 30 feet gain a +1 morale bonus on attack rolls, weapon damage rolls, and saving throws against fear and charm effects so long as they can see and hear you.

noble.name: Voice of Authority (Su)
noble.desc: Your word carries compulsion. Once per day you may speak a one-word command to a single creature within 30 feet as though casting command (Will DC 10 + {half_level} + your Charisma modifier negates), and you gain a +4 competence bonus on Diplomacy and Intimidate checks.

noble.name: Estate and Title (Ex)
noble.desc: You hold a landed title with all its wealth and obligations. You command a manor, 20 sworn retainers, and a monthly income of 250 gp; once per week you may muster up to 10 men-at-arms (warrior 1) to serve you for a single day.

noble.name: Diplomatic Immunity (Su)
noble.desc: Your station shields you as surely as armor. You gain a +2 insight bonus to AC and on all saving throws, and the first time each day a creature would attack you it must succeed at a Will save (DC 10 + {half_level} + your Charisma modifier) or hesitate, losing that attack as it reckons with your standing.

noble.name: Grand Marshal's Banner (Su)
noble.desc: You lead hosts to war beneath your standard. Allies within 60 feet gain a +3 morale bonus on attack rolls, weapon damage rolls, and saving throws, and are immune to fear and the shaken condition while they can see your banner. You may rally a routed or panicked ally as an immediate action.

noble.name: Lordly Largesse (Sp)
noble.desc: Your wealth is a power unto itself. You may dispense rewards and bribes that few can refuse, gaining a +6 competence bonus on Diplomacy checks, and 3 times per day you may bestow a boon on a creature as heroism (caster level equal to your character level). Your monthly income exceeds 5,000 gp.

noble.name: Regent's Decree (Su)
noble.desc: You speak with the weight of law itself. Once per day you may issue a decree as greater command, affecting one creature per two character levels within 60 feet (Will DC 10 + {half_level} + your Charisma modifier negates). Creatures that fail are dominated by your authority for 1 round and obey a single lawful command.

noble.name: Untouchable Authority (Su)
noble.desc: None dare raise a hand against your person without consequence. You gain a +4 insight bonus to AC and on all saving throws, and any creature that attacks you must first succeed at a Will save (DC 10 + {half_level} + your Charisma modifier) or be staggered for 1 round, cowed by the enormity of striking your station.

noble.name: Royal Bloodline (Su)
noble.desc: The blood of god-touched kings runs in your veins, and the world bends to it. You radiate a 60-foot aura of majesty: allies gain a +4 morale bonus on attacks, damage, and saves and are immune to fear, while enemies must succeed at a Will save (DC 10 + {half_level} + your Charisma modifier) or be shaken for as long as they remain in the aura. Once per day you may speak a word of sovereign command as mass charm monster.

noble.name: Crown of the God-King (Su)
noble.desc: You rule as a living deity, your word indistinguishable from divine law. You command armies numbering in the thousands and an empire's treasury; you do not age and cannot die so long as your dynasty endures. Three times per day you may issue an absolute command to all creatures within 100 feet as greater command (Will DC 10 + {half_level} + your Charisma modifier, with no save for non-sovereign creatures of fewer than half your Hit Dice), and your mere presence grants you a +6 insight bonus to AC and on all saving throws.

occult.name: Hedge-Witch's Eye (Ex)
occult.desc: A lifetime reading omens in guts and tea-leaves has sharpened {class}'s feel for the unseen. Grants a +2 competence bonus on Knowledge (arcana) and Knowledge (planes) checks to identify spirits, the undead, and dark magic.

occult.name: Evil Eye (Ex)
occult.desc: {class} can fix a victim with a baleful stare laden with petty malice. Three times per day as a standard action, one creature within 30 feet that {class} can see takes a -2 penalty on saving throws against fear for 1 minute (no save to resist this minor curse).

occult.name: Graveyard Manners (Ex)
occult.desc: Long nights spent in crypts and at deathbeds have inured {class} to the company of corpses. Grants a +2 competence bonus on Heal checks to treat the dying and a +2 morale bonus on saving throws against fear and disease.

occult.name: Petty Hex (Su)
occult.desc: {class} knows one minor witch's hex (such as a sleep curse, a fortune jinx, or a misfortune touch). They may use it at will as a standard action; the save DC is 10 + half their character level + their Charisma modifier, and a target that saves is immune to that hex for 24 hours.

occult.name: Cultist's Cant (Ex)
occult.desc: Schooled in whispered creeds and secret signs, {class} sways the faithful and the fearful alike. Grants a +2 competence bonus on Intimidate checks and a +2 competence bonus on Bluff checks made to spread rumor or conceal heresy.

occult.name: Cantrips of the Coven (Sp)
occult.desc: {class} can cast bleed, detect magic, touch of fatigue, and putrefy food and drink at will as spell-like abilities (caster level equal to their character level).

occult.name: Bestow Curse (Sp)
occult.desc: Once per day {class} may lay a lingering curse on a foe by touch, as the bestow curse spell (Will negates, DC 13 + their Charisma modifier; caster level equal to their character level), saddling the victim with a -4 penalty to an ability score or a 50% chance to act uselessly each round.

occult.name: Animate Dead (Sp)
occult.desc: {class} can call the slain back to shambling service. Once per day they may cast animate dead as a spell-like ability (caster level equal to their character level), raising skeletons or zombies whose total Hit Dice do not exceed twice their character level.

occult.name: Mask of Dread (Su)
occult.desc: A palpable aura of menace clings to {class}. As a standard action, a number of times per day equal to 3 + their Charisma modifier, they may cause one creature within 30 feet to become shaken for 1d4 rounds (Will negates, DC 10 + half their character level + their Charisma modifier).

occult.name: Blood Sacrifice (Su)
occult.desc: {class} can spill the life of another to fuel their dark art. Once per day, as a full-round action against a helpless or willing creature, they slay or grievously wound it and gain a +2 profane bonus on attack rolls, saving throws, and caster level checks for 10 minutes.

occult.name: Life-Drinker's Touch (Su)
occult.desc: {class} drains vitality with a withering grasp. A number of times per day equal to half their character level (minimum 1), as a melee touch attack, they deal 1d6 negative energy damage per two character levels (Fortitude half, DC 10 + half their level + their Charisma modifier) and heal themselves an equal amount.

occult.name: Forbidden Divination (Sp)
occult.desc: {class} wrests stolen knowledge from spirits and the dead. Once per day they may cast augury, and once per day speak with dead, as spell-like abilities (caster level equal to their character level), questioning the slain or reading the threads of fate at a price the gods would forbid.

occult.name: Profane Ward (Su)
occult.desc: The dark powers {class} courts wreathe them in a shield of unholy negation. Grants a +2 profane bonus on all saving throws and a +2 profane bonus to AC against attacks made by creatures of good alignment.

occult.name: Major Hexes (Su)
occult.desc: {class} commands two major hexes (such as a death-curse, a withering touch, or an agony hex). They may use each once per round as a standard action; the save DC is 10 + half their character level + their Charisma modifier, and the hexes draw on a creeping, supernatural malice no mundane ward turns aside.

occult.name: Command Undead (Su)
occult.desc: {class} channels negative energy to seize control of the dead. A number of times per day equal to 3 + their Charisma modifier they may rebuke or command undead in a 30-foot burst (Will negates, DC 10 + half their level + their Charisma modifier); a single use can bring a number of Hit Dice of undead under their sway equal to twice their character level.

occult.name: Aura of Dread (Su)
occult.desc: A 30-foot aura of supernatural terror radiates from {class}. Enemies that enter or begin their turn within it must succeed at a Will save (DC 10 + half their character level + their Charisma modifier) or be shaken for as long as they remain, and a creature that fails by 5 or more is frightened for 1 round instead.

contextNotes.text: Enemies within 30 ft. shaken (Will negates) from your aura of dread

occult.name: Diabolist's Pact (Sp)
occult.desc: {class} has bargained with the powers of the lower planes. Once per day they may summon a fiendish servitor (as summon monster V, drawing only evil outsiders) and once per day cast a 5th- or 6th-level infernal spell such as contagion, dominate person, or planar binding (lesser) as a spell-like ability at a caster level equal to their character level.

occult.name: Crown of Bone (Su)
occult.desc: Death's favor armors {class} against death itself. They gain immunity to fear, disease, and energy drain, a +4 profane bonus on saving throws against death effects and necromancy, and once per day may negate a critical hit or sneak attack scored against them as the dark powers turn the blow aside.

occult.name: Mass Dread (Su)
occult.desc: {class} unleashes a wave of soul-freezing horror. Once per day, as a standard action, every enemy within 60 feet must succeed at a Will save (DC 10 + half their character level + their Charisma modifier) or be panicked for 1d4 rounds; those who succeed are still shaken for the same duration. While any creature remains afraid of them, {class} gains a +2 profane bonus on attack rolls and caster level checks.

contextNotes.text: +2 profane to attack while any foe is afraid of you

occult.name: Lich-Lord's Dominion (Su)
occult.desc: {class} has become a Dark Sovereign who has cheated the grave. They gain immunity to death effects, energy drain, and ability drain, DR 10/bludgeoning and magic, and fast healing 5 so long as they are not in consecrated ground. As a standard action they may rip the soul from a living foe within 30 feet with a finger of death (Fortitude partial, DC 10 + half their character level + their Charisma modifier, usable once per day), and the slain rise as undead under their eternal command.

occult.name: Throne of the Damned (Su)
occult.desc: {class} rules as a tyrant-prince of the dark powers, their will a law of dread. Grants a +4 profane bonus on all saving throws and to AC, and a 60-foot aura in which all of their curses, hexes, fear effects, and necromancy spells impose a -2 penalty on the saving throws made to resist them; allied undead within the aura gain a +2 profane bonus on attack rolls and saving throws.

wayfarer.name: Trail Sense (Ex)
wayfarer.desc: A lifetime of muddy roads and cold camps has sharpened your senses. You gain a +2 competence bonus on Survival checks and on Perception checks to notice hazards along a path.

wayfarer.name: Roadworn Feet (Ex)
wayfarer.desc: You have walked farther than most folk ever will. You can hustle for 1 additional hour each day before risking nonlethal damage, and you gain a +2 competence bonus on Constitution checks to avoid fatigue from a forced march.

wayfarer.name: Scavenger's Knack (Ex)
wayfarer.desc: You make do with what the road leaves behind. You gain a +2 competence bonus on Appraise checks and on Survival checks to forage food and water in the wild.

wayfarer.name: Nimble Delver (Ex)
wayfarer.desc: Tight crawls and treacherous footing hold no fear for you. You gain a +2 competence bonus on Acrobatics checks and on Climb checks made underground or amid ruins.

wayfarer.name: Lockpick's Touch (Ex)
wayfarer.desc: You have coaxed open more strongboxes than you can count. You gain a +2 competence bonus on Disable Device checks and on Sleight of Hand checks, the deft hands of a seasoned treasure-hunter.

wayfarer.name: Wanderer's Bearings (Ex)
wayfarer.desc: You never truly lose your way. You always know which way is north and roughly how far you have travelled, and you gain a +1 competence bonus on initiative checks from your traveller's wariness.

wayfarer.name: Monster Lore (Ex)
wayfarer.desc: You have studied the beasts that prowl the dark places of the world. You gain a +2 competence bonus on Knowledge checks to identify creatures, and against any foe whose weaknesses you have identified you deal +1 bonus damage.

contextNotes.text: +1 damage vs a foe whose type you have identified with Knowledge

wayfarer.name: Trapfinder's Eye (Ex)
wayfarer.desc: You spot the telltale seam and the too-clean floor where others see nothing. You gain a +3 competence bonus on Perception checks to find traps and on Disable Device checks to disarm them, and you can attempt to disarm magical traps.

wayfarer.name: Second Wind (Ex)
wayfarer.desc: When the fight turns desperate you dig deep and rally. Once per day as a standard action you may heal yourself a number of hit points equal to your level + your Constitution modifier and remove the fatigued condition.

wayfarer.name: Improvised Arsenal (Ex)
wayfarer.desc: A chair leg, a torch, a length of chain — any of it is a weapon in your hands. You take no penalty for wielding improvised weapons, treat them as having one size category larger, and gain a +1 competence bonus on attack rolls made with them.

contextNotes.text: +1 attack with improvised weapons and no improvised penalty

wayfarer.name: Danger Sense (Ex)
wayfarer.desc: The prickle at the back of your neck has saved your life a hundred times. You gain a +3 insight bonus on Reflex saves and on initiative checks, and you cannot be caught flat-footed even when surprised.

wayfarer.name: Slayer's Study (Ex)
wayfarer.desc: You have made a science of killing monsters. As a move action you may study one visible foe; against that foe you gain a +2 insight bonus on attack rolls and deal +1d6 bonus damage until it dies or the encounter ends. You may study a new foe each time the first falls.

contextNotes.text: vs studied foe: +2 insight attack and +1d6 damage

wayfarer.name: Evasive Footwork (Ex)
wayfarer.desc: You have dodged collapsing ceilings and dragon-breath alike. You gain evasion (no damage on a successful Reflex save against effects that allow a save for half) and a +2 dodge bonus to AC against attacks of opportunity.

wayfarer.name: Veteran Delver's Cache (Ex)
wayfarer.desc: You always seem to have the one thing the situation demands. Three times per day you may produce a single piece of nonmagical adventuring gear worth up to 50 gp from your packs and pockets as if you had prepared it in advance.

wayfarer.name: Pathbreaker's Stride (Ex)
wayfarer.desc: No terrain and no fetters can hold you for long. You ignore difficult terrain, gain a +5 competence bonus on Escape Artist checks and on saves against being grappled, entangled, or held, and you may attempt a new save to escape any binding once per round as a free action.

wayfarer.name: Bane of Monsters (Ex)
wayfarer.desc: The hides of aberrations and the scales of dragons part before your blade. You deal +2d6 bonus damage against monstrous humanoids, aberrations, dragons, and magical beasts, and you gain a +4 insight bonus on saves against their special attacks.

contextNotes.text: +2d6 damage vs monstrous humanoids, aberrations, dragons, and magical beasts

wayfarer.name: Grandmaster Trapsmith (Ex)
wayfarer.desc: No vault was ever built that you could not crack. You may take 10 on Disable Device and Perception checks even when threatened or distracted, you automatically detect any trap or hidden door within 30 feet, and you gain a +8 competence bonus on Disable Device checks against magical traps.

wayfarer.name: Unkillable Wanderer (Ex)
wayfarer.desc: You have walked out of places that swallow heroes whole. Once per day, when reduced to 0 or fewer hit points, you instead drop to 1 hit point and heal a number of hit points equal to twice your level. You gain DR 5/— against the first hit you take each round.

wayfarer.name: World-Walker (Su)
wayfarer.desc: You have crossed deserts, oceans, and the boundaries between worlds. You gain a +5 luck bonus on all saving throws and may, once per day, cast teleport as a spell-like ability (caster level equal to your level) to escape any danger, carrying yourself and your gear to any place you have seen.

wayfarer.name: Legendary Hero (Ex)
wayfarer.desc: Your name is sung in a hundred taverns, and the songs are true. You gain a +4 luck bonus on attack rolls, damage rolls, and AC, treat your weapons as bane against any creature you have studied, and once per day may automatically confirm a critical hit and reroll any one failed d20 roll. No mundane trap, lock, or binding can hold you.

elementalist.name: Cinder Spark (Sp)
elementalist.desc: {class} can snap a fingertip and conjure a guttering flame, lighting torches or candles at will and producing a spark hot enough to ignite tinder. You may cast spark and light at will as spell-like abilities with a caster level equal to your character level.

elementalist.name: Elemental Sense (Ex)
elementalist.desc: You feel heat, frost, and tremors that others miss. You gain a +2 competence bonus on Survival checks made to predict weather and on Knowledge (planes) checks about elemental creatures and effects.

elementalist.name: Warm Hearth (Ex)
elementalist.desc: Your bound element keeps the worst of the weather at bay. You can exist comfortably in conditions between 20 and 110 degrees Fahrenheit without needing to make Fortitude saves, and you gain a +2 competence bonus on saves against the remaining environmental heat or cold.

contextNotes.text: +2 vs environmental heat/cold

elementalist.name: Kindle Bolt (Sp)
elementalist.desc: You hurl a mote of your bound element as a ranged touch attack dealing 1d6+1 energy damage (fire, cold, electricity, or acid, chosen when you take this ability) at a range of 30 feet. You can throw this bolt 3 + your Charisma modifier times per day.

elementalist.name: Ember Ward (Ex)
elementalist.desc: Your skin shrugs off your chosen element. You gain energy resistance 5 against one energy type (fire, cold, electricity, or acid), chosen when you gain this ability.

elementalist.name: Sure Footing (Su)
elementalist.desc: The elements steady your stride. You gain a +1 insight bonus to AC and a +1 insight bonus on Acrobatics checks, as the air and earth themselves shift to keep you upright.

elementalist.name: Elemental Blast (Sp)
elementalist.desc: You unleash a 15-foot cone or a single 30-foot ranged touch of your bound element dealing 1d6 energy damage per two character levels (Reflex DC 10 + half your level + your Charisma modifier for half). You may use this blast 3 + your Charisma modifier times per day.

elementalist.name: Stride the Element (Su)
elementalist.desc: Your bound element carries you where others cannot tread. Choose one mode: you can walk across water or lava unharmed, burrow 10 feet through earth, or ignore difficult terrain made of your element. You gain a +2 untyped bonus on initiative as the element answers your call.

elementalist.name: Hardened Hide (Su)
elementalist.desc: Stone, frost, or living flame sheathes your flesh. You gain a +2 natural armor bonus to AC, and your unarmed strikes and natural attacks deal an additional 1 point of your chosen energy damage.

elementalist.name: Attuned Soul (Ex)
elementalist.desc: You and your element are one. You gain energy resistance 10 against your chosen energy type and a +2 resistance bonus on saving throws against spells and effects of that same element.

contextNotes.text: +2 resistance vs your element's spells/effects

elementalist.name: Elemental Aura (Su)
elementalist.desc: As a swift action you wreathe yourself in your element for 1 minute, dealing 1d6 energy damage to any creature that strikes you in melee or that you strike, and granting you a +2 deflection bonus to AC. You may sustain this aura a number of rounds per day equal to 3 + your character level.

elementalist.name: Ride the Storm (Su)
elementalist.desc: The winds, currents, and quaking earth obey you. You gain a fly speed of 40 feet (average maneuverability) while aloft on elemental winds, and you can swim or burrow at your base land speed. You also gain a +4 untyped bonus on Fly checks.

elementalist.name: Quenchless Conflagration (Sp)
elementalist.desc: Your signature blast grows devastating, dealing 1d6 energy damage per character level in a 20-foot-radius burst within 100 feet (Reflex DC 10 + half your level + your Charisma modifier for half). You may unleash this conflagration 1 + your Charisma modifier times per day.

elementalist.name: Shape the Land (Sp)
elementalist.desc: You command terrain of your bound element. Once per day you may reshape the battlefield, casting one of stone shape, control water, gust of wind, or wall of fire as a spell-like ability with a caster level equal to your character level (DC 10 + half your level + your Charisma modifier).

elementalist.name: Master of the Four Winds (Su)
elementalist.desc: You have mastered every face of your element. You gain immunity to your chosen energy type and energy resistance 20 against all others, and your elemental blasts ignore the first 10 points of a target's energy resistance. Allies within 30 feet gain energy resistance 5 against your chosen element.

elementalist.name: Call the Tempest (Sp)
elementalist.desc: You summon a regional storm of your element. Once per day you may cast control weather and call lightning storm (or its earthen, icy, or fiery equivalent) as spell-like abilities, raising blizzards, sandstorms, or thunderheads with a caster level equal to your character level. The storm rages for 1 hour per character level.

elementalist.name: Conjure Elemental Servitor (Sp)
elementalist.desc: A greater spirit of your element answers your summons. Once per day you may summon a Large elemental of your chosen element (or two Medium elementals) that serve you for 1 minute per character level, as summon monster. You gain a +4 morale bonus on Charisma checks to bind or bargain with elemental creatures.

elementalist.name: Body of the Element (Su)
elementalist.desc: For up to 1 minute per character level each day you assume an elemental body, gaining the elemental subtype, a +4 size bonus to one physical ability score, your chosen movement mode at 60 feet, and immunity to bleed, paralysis, poison, sleep, and stunning while transformed. You may divide this duration across several uses.

elementalist.name: Avatar of the Storm (Su)
elementalist.desc: You become a living embodiment of your element, wreathed forever in flame, frost, lightning, or living stone. You gain immunity to your chosen energy type, energy resistance 30 against all others, immunity to critical hits and sneak attacks, fast healing 5, and a +4 inherent bonus to your caster level. Once per round your touch or weapon deals an extra 6d6 energy damage of your element.

elementalist.name: Sovereign of the Inner Sphere (Su)
elementalist.desc: The elemental planes themselves bend to your will. Each day you may unleash a cataclysm three times, choosing fire storm, earthquake, storm of vengeance, or whirlwind as a spell-like ability (DC 18 + your Charisma modifier). You no longer age, need not eat, drink, or breathe, and any creature within 60 feet that defies you must succeed at a Will save (DC 10 + half your level + your Charisma modifier) or be shaken by your elemental majesty.

villain.name: Backalley Threat (Ex)
villain.desc: A muttered promise of violence does most of your work. You gain a +2 competence bonus on Intimidate checks made to demoralize or coerce a single creature.

villain.name: Cutthroat's Eye (Ex)
villain.desc: You learned to read a mark for the soft, weak places. You gain a +1 untyped bonus on damage rolls against any foe that is shaken, frightened, or denied its Dexterity bonus to AC.

contextNotes.text: +1 damage vs shaken/frightened or flat-footed foes

villain.name: No Honor Lost (Ex)
villain.desc: You feel nothing when you fight dirty, so dirty fighting comes easy. You gain a +1 untyped bonus on combat maneuver checks made to dirty trick, disarm, or grapple a flat-footed or helpless foe.

contextNotes.text: +1 CMB on dirty trick/disarm/grapple vs flat-footed or helpless foes

villain.name: Brigand's Menace (Ex)
villain.desc: You have shaken down enough victims to make fear your trade. You gain a +3 competence bonus on Intimidate checks, and demoralizing a creature with Intimidate takes you only a move action instead of a standard action.

villain.name: Savage Strike (Ex)
villain.desc: You strike to maim, not to win. You gain a +1 morale bonus on attack and damage rolls against any creature that is below half its maximum hit points.

contextNotes.text: +1 morale to attack and damage vs foes below half HP

villain.name: Cruel Resolve (Ex)
villain.desc: Years of inflicting pain have left you numb to your own. You gain a +2 untyped bonus on saving throws against fear, pain, and compulsion effects, and you are never sickened by the sight of blood or suffering.

contextNotes.text: +2 on saves vs fear, pain, and compulsion

villain.name: Press the Mob (Ex)
villain.desc: You know how to whip a crowd into a frenzy. As a standard action you may make an Intimidate check against every creature within 30 feet that can hear you (DC 10 + your level); those that fail are shaken for {half_level} rounds. You can use this 3 times per day.

villain.name: Brutal Beating (Ex)
villain.desc: Your blows are meant to break spirits as well as bones. Whenever you deal damage in melee to a foe, that foe is sickened for 1 round, and against shaken foes your melee attacks deal an extra 1d6 points of damage.

contextNotes.text: Melee hits sicken for 1 round; +1d6 vs shaken foes

villain.name: Coercive Interrogation (Ex)
villain.desc: Few keep their secrets once you go to work on them. You gain a +4 competence bonus on Intimidate checks made to force a creature to act friendly, answer questions truthfully, or surrender, and you reduce the time such an Intimidate check takes by half.

villain.name: Slaver's Lash (Ex)
villain.desc: You have mastered the tools of bondage and the lash. You gain a +2 untyped bonus on attack and damage rolls with whips, nets, and manacles, and any creature you successfully grapple or pin takes a -2 penalty on attempts to escape that grapple.

contextNotes.text: +2 attack and damage with whips/nets; pinned foes take -2 to escape

villain.name: Aura of Menace (Ex)
villain.desc: Your sheer brutality radiates from you like a stench. Enemies within 20 feet take a -2 penalty on attack rolls, saving throws against fear, and Will saves so long as they can see you and you are conscious.

villain.name: Terror Tactics (Ex)
villain.desc: You know exactly how to break a will. When you successfully demoralize a foe, instead of being shaken it is frightened for 1 round and shaken for {half_level} rounds thereafter; a foe already shaken by you that you demoralize again becomes panicked for 1 round (Will DC 10 + half your level + your Charisma modifier negates the panic).

villain.name: Reaver's Onslaught (Ex)
villain.desc: You fight like a force of ruin, hewing through the weak. You gain a +3 untyped bonus on melee damage rolls, and whenever you reduce a creature to 0 or fewer hit points you may immediately take a single melee attack against another foe within reach as a free action.

villain.name: Captain of Cutthroats (Ex)
villain.desc: The brutes follow because they fear you more than the enemy. Allies within 30 feet gain a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls and on saving throws against fear while you are conscious, and as a standard action up to {half_level} times per day you may direct an ally within 30 feet to take an immediate melee attack as a reaction. You can use the directed attack 3 times per day.

villain.name: Reign of Fear (Su)
villain.desc: Dread bleeds off you like a physical force. Enemies within 30 feet take a -4 penalty on saving throws against fear and on Will saves and are sickened while they remain in the aura; any enemy that enters the aura or starts its turn within it must succeed at a Will save (DC 10 + half your level + your Charisma modifier) or be shaken for as long as it stays within 30 feet of you.

villain.name: Warlord's Command (Ex)
villain.desc: Your word is law to every brute and cutthroat in earshot. Three times per day as a standard action you may issue a battle-command to all allies within 60 feet who can hear you, granting them an extra move or attack action this round and a +4 morale bonus on attack rolls, damage rolls, and saves against fear until the start of your next turn.

villain.name: Incite the Riot (Sp)
villain.desc: You can turn a crowd into a weapon. Once per day you may rouse every non-hostile creature within 60 feet into a murderous frenzy as the mass form of rage combined with a compulsion to attack a target you designate (Will DC 10 + half your level + your Charisma modifier negates); the frenzy lasts {level} rounds. You may use this ability once per day.

villain.name: Torturer's Mastery (Ex)
villain.desc: No body and no mind can withstand you. You automatically succeed at Intimidate checks to coerce a helpless or restrained creature, and against any foe that is shaken or frightened your melee attacks deal an extra 2d6 points of damage and ignore the first 10 points of damage reduction.

contextNotes.text: +2d6 and ignore DR 10 vs shaken/frightened foes

villain.name: Dread Tyrant (Su)
villain.desc: You are a sovereign of terror whose presence unmakes courage. Enemies within 60 feet take a -6 penalty on attack rolls, saving throws, and skill checks, and each enemy that can see you must succeed at a Will save (DC 10 + half your level + your Charisma modifier) each round or be panicked for 1 round; a creature that fails by 5 or more instead cowers helplessly. You are immune to fear, mind-affecting effects, and morale penalties.

villain.name: Warlord of Ruin (Ex)
villain.desc: You command armies of brutes and break kingdoms beneath your heel. You gain a +6 untyped bonus on attack and damage rolls and a +4 morale bonus to AC; all allies within 100 feet gain a +6 morale bonus on attack and damage rolls and immunity to fear while you live. Three times per day you may, as a free action, force every enemy within 60 feet that you have damaged this combat to make a Will save (DC 10 + half your level + your Charisma modifier) or flee in panic for {level} rounds.
